About MetaOptima Technology Inc.
--------------------------------

MetaOptima: empowering users with advanced technologies  
  
MetaOptima is a digital health tech company dedicated to revolutionizing the dermatology and skin care industry with affordable, effective and intelligent tools. In order to provide state-of-the-art care, both medical professionals and their patients should be equipped with advanced tools.  
  
We are proud to offer two products designed to enhance the quality of patient care and organization while streamlining services for maximum efficiency: DermEngine and MoleScope. DermEngine is an intelligent skin analytics platform designed to provide medical experts with smart technologies to enhance workflows, organization and communications. MoleScope is a digital dermoscopic attachment for smartphones/tablets that allows users to take medical grade quality images of their skin.  
  
Here at MetaOptima, we take pride in our bold vision to bring digital healthcare and mobile technologies together to save lives and contribute to better health outcomes. We work hard to build a successful company with strong values and sense of community, as well as create jobs and develop tools that make the world a better place for patients, doctors, and businesses.

About Chesapeake Urology Associates/Continence Center
-----------------------------------------------------

Chesapeake Urology is the largest urology practice in the Mid-Atlantic region and the premier group in the nation, providing a comprehensive array of urologic services to men, women, and children. Our integrated approach to urologic care provides patients with access to leading urologists and staff, including fellowship-trained doctors, radiation oncologists, a uropathologist, and a comprehensive support team of healthcare professionals that includes physician assistants, patient navigators, and nurse practitioners. Our urologists are skilled in the most sophisticated diagnostic tools, highly advanced treatments and therapies for all urologic conditions, and leading-edge technology for micro-surgical techniques and laparoscopic and minimally invasive surgical procedures. Chesapeake Urology’s robust clinical trials program is spearheaded by renowned clinical investigators.  
  
In addition to clinical excellence, Chesapeake Urology is known as one of the region’s leading employers, having been named one of the top 100 Places to Work in healthcare nationally by Modern Healthcare magazine and Becker’s Hospital Review & Becker’s ASC Review, and locally by Baltimore magazine and the Baltimore Sun. Our mission is to ensure that every patient has a superior experience and our culture is built upon giving back to our community through a wide variety of health and education programs and services.  
  
Chesapeake Urology operates 28 medical offices and 18 AAAHC-certified ambulatory surgery centers in Anne Arundel, Baltimore, Harford, Howard, Carroll, Montgomery, Prince George’s, Wicomico, Worchester, MD counties, Baltimore City, and Sussex County, DE, and has a staff of more than 800 including 87 physicians, 80 who are urologists.

About Double Encore
-------------------

Double Encore was one of the early movers in the iPhone app consulting space. The company has a design-driven process, which it believes results in higher quality apps. The company also focuses on iPhone strategy through a program called "Start to Market" which recognizes that high-quality development alone does not guarantee success on the App Store. Double Encore's customers include JetBlue, Major League Soccer, The SPEED Channel, and Denver Art Museum just to name a few. Double Encore has been recognized by Communicate Arts Interactive for their work developing the 91st PGA Championship and iBike Coach. In the early days of the app economy, the company developed the Brightkite iPhone application, which has been favorably reviewed by TechCrunch, Macworld, and a host of other web sites. Other applications developed by the company include a series language learning apps called PencilBot and The Bad Decision Blocker (featured by TechCrunch, ABCNews, and CNN). The company also built the 2nd generation of Liverail's SDK for iPhone which allows app developers to monetize their apps via embedded video pre-roll. In May 2009, the company announced that in the first 10 months of operation it has shipped 19 app releases, which is an average of one every 16 days. Double Encore was founded in summer 2008.

Located in Northbrook, Illinois, Saf-T-Gard International, Inc. is a privately-held family-owned and operated global supplier of industrial safety products. Founded in 1936 as Latex Glove Manufacturing Company, Saf T-Gard quickly evolved into a predominant manufacturer, distributor, importer and exporter of personal protective equipment, environmental safety, facility safety, first aid, public safety and electrical safety. Today, Saf-T-Gard carries on the tradition that was started more than 85 years ago: bringing customers the products, training and service they need to keep employees safe in the workplace. Saf-T-Gard is an active member of the National Safety Council (NSC), International Safety Equipment Association (ISEA) and the AD Safety Network, and provides thousands of solutions from recognized brand names in addition to its renowned line of proprietary brands. Saf-T-Gard actively operates the Voltgard Test Lab, one of the largest, independent, NAIL4PET-accredited test labs for rubber insulating products in the United States. To learn more, please visit www.saftgard.com or call 1-800-548-GARD (4273).

About Luke's Lobster
--------------------

Luke’s Lobster was born out of the dream of Maine native and third-generation lobsterman Luke Holden to bring the quality, affordable lobster rolls of his youth to the big city. After meeting business partner Ben Conniff on Craigslist (yes, Craigslist), the two twenty-somethings opened their first lobster shack in a 250 square foot space in NYC’s East Village in October 2009. Nearly a decade later Luke’s Lobster shacks can be found in ten states across the U.S., and in Japan and Singapore. You can also find Luke's products in Whole Foods Markets nationwide and can have them shipped anywhere in the US through our Online Market!  
  
As part of its mission to serve the best tasting seafood, sourced responsibly, Luke’s Lobster also built a state-of-the-art seafood facility in Saco, Maine, that allows the company to not only buy lobsters directly from fishermen at the dock but immediately steam, pick, and send them to its shacks to ensure perfect flavor and texture with every bite and transparent sourcing detail for its guests. In 2018, Luke & Ben furthered their growing seafood company’s commitment to sustainability and socially conscious business practices by becoming a certified B Corporation®, reflecting Luke’s Lobster’s deep devotion to each of its communities, its family of teammates, and the environment. Please visit www.lukeslobster.com for more information.

About Convex
------------

A Convex | Consultoria e Integração de Sistemas pertence ao Grupo Satec, multinacional espanhola integradora de soluções tecnológicas e especializada em serviços avançados associados às novas Tecnologias de Informação. O Grupo Satec conta com presença local em 11 países.  
  
Os princípios que governam a acção da Convex são: a sólida base tecnológica e a elevada qualificação dos seus profissionais, juntamente com uma criteriosa selecção de parceiros tecnológicos - com atenção constante na qualidade do produto ou serviço -, a inovação contínua, ampla experiência em implementação de soluções - em mais de mil Clientes -, e o foco constante no Cliente com o firme compromisso de oferecer soluções e serviços inovadores para atender às suas necessidades específicas.  
  
A Convex tem um amplo portfólio de soluções e serviços TIC que cobrem as necessidades do Cliente. É feita a recolha e análise dos seus requisitos específicos para, posteriormente, avançar com as fases de desenvolvimento, implementação e manutenção. Com a experiência obtida ao longo de quase 25 anos de actividade a Convex é o parceiro certo para fornecer soluções e serviços específicos para qualquer sector vertical de mercado.  
  
Com a finalidade de complementar o seu core business, o Grupo Satec participa na InterHost - empresa focada em soluções de centros de dados em modelo hosting e fornecimento de soluções as a service na cloud.

His expertise in food packaging and fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) positions him as a thought leader in developing sustainable packaging practices that meet the evolving demands of the market. About Vantage Robotics
----------------------

Vantage makes UAVs and UAV components for customers, including the U.S. Army, Navy, Marines, Coast Guard, FBI, NASA, DEA, and CNN. Our first product, Snap, achieved a landmark FAA waiver for commercial flight over people. Our second product, Vesper, was one of five products selected by the Pentagon for use by the federal government. We’re currently making the next generation micro drone for the U.S. Army’s $100M Soldier Borne Sensor Program and a family of modular micro-gimbals as part of the Pentagon’s Blue UAS program.  
  
Vantage has been awarded over $22M in R&D contracts over the last two years and raised $20M in venture funding. The company has strong backing from VCs who previously backed Twitter and Zoom, the founder of Insitu, and the Pentagon’s Defense Innovation Unit. We are a team of Stanford engineers, DARPA Grand Challenge winners, IDEO and Volkswagen alums, NASA roboticists, 3D printer designers, and pioneering software developers. We’re also ardent kite surfers, mountain bikers, rock climbers, surfers, and award winning pilots. We work to achieve ambitious goals but also to achieve meaningful  
lives.

About KOTRA
-----------

CEO's Message  
  
Since 1962 as part of the Korea’s first 5-year Economic Plan, KOTRA has been dedicated to creating new export markets and increasing Korea’s trade value, which reached $1 trillion in 2011. In the late 1990s, the agency helped Korea overcome the Financial Crisis by starting its foreign direct investment promotion division. And in the last half century, KOTRA has played a significant role in supporting Korean companies expanding overseas.  
  
Today, the world economy is more volatile than ever due to the European financial crisis, China's hindered economic growth, upcoming elections in 15 countries and security issues in the Middle East. In preparation for a rapidly changing market environment, and using Korea’s expansive FTA network, KOTRA is focusing on the globalization of SMEs, the backbone of the Korean economy, by providing them with customized support related to global business establishment and export.  
  
To further expand Korea’s trade sector, KOTRA is increasing the exports of new growth industries such as the knowledge service industry, medical-bio industry and green industry. The culture-based Korean Wave is making economic waves as well with its high export value. By supporting these and other industries, KOTRA contributes to the economic development of Korea and developing countries through technological innovation, industrial infrastructure formation and HR development.  
  
We invite you to be a part of our journey of growth.

What services does KOTRA provide to support Korean exporters?

KOTRA offers a range of services designed to assist Korean exporters in entering and succeeding in global markets. These services include market research, trade promotion, and matchmaking with potential foreign buyers. KOTRA also provides infrastructural support to enhance the global competitiveness of Korean companies, helping them navigate international trade regulations and standards.

How can KOTRA help foreign companies interested in sourcing products from Korea?

KOTRA facilitates virtual access to the Korean market for foreign buyers. By utilizing its extensive network and resources, KOTRA can connect foreign companies with Korean suppliers and manufacturers. They provide tailored assistance, including product sourcing, supplier verification, and negotiation support, ensuring that foreign companies find reliable partners in Korea.

What industries does KOTRA focus on for export promotion?

KOTRA supports a wide range of industries, including but not limited to technology, automotive, electronics, cosmetics, and food products. The organization is committed to identifying and promoting new future markets and business areas, ensuring that Korean exporters can tap into emerging trends and demands in various sectors globally.

How does KOTRA assist in creating global partnerships for Korean companies?

KOTRA plays a crucial role in fostering global partnerships by organizing trade fairs, business matching events, and networking opportunities. They connect Korean companies with international corporations and facilitate collaborations that can lead to joint ventures, investments, and other strategic alliances, ultimately enhancing the global footprint of Korean businesses.

What resources are available for new export companies through KOTRA?

KOTRA provides various resources for new export companies, including training programs, workshops, and access to market intelligence. They offer guidance on export procedures, compliance with international standards, and strategies for effective market entry. Additionally, KOTRA's network of trade experts is available to provide personalized support to help new exporters navigate the complexities of international trade.

How can I get in touch with KOTRA for assistance with international trade?

You can reach out to KOTRA through their official website at http://www.kotra.or.kr, where you can find contact information for their various offices and departments. Additionally, you can inquire about specific services, request consultations, or access resources tailored to your international trade needs. About Wyll
----------

Wyll est un pure player, entièrement indépendant, véritable Hub en Occitanie sur les sujets liés aux écosystèmes 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗢𝗽𝘀, 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 & 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱 !  
  
Cette équipe de toulousains passionnés est convaincue qu’aujourd’hui, une approche DevOps est indissociable d’une ouverture vers le CLOUD de certains services dans un contexte où les traitements de la DATA sont de plus en plus complexes  
C’est pourquoi nous accompagnons nos clients sur ces 3 axes et proposons dans le même temps, des projets/évolutions/formations/certifications à nos experts sur l’intégralité de ce scope.  
  
Wyll - c’est avant tout une bande de mordus de tech oui... MAIS PAS QUE !  
  
Pour nous un bonne qualité de vie pro/perso passe par du temps alloué à d’autres passions :  
#jeudego #rando #escalade #curling #guitare #couture #ski #moto #mcdo #oenologie  
D’ailleurs, on finance vos passions (oui... TOUTES vos passions... même les pizzas) !  
  
Autour d’un café, d’une mousse ou sur le slack vous pourrez aussi entendre parler de sujets plus légers...  
#switch, #OSS117, #Kaamelott, #physiquequantique, #cotedeboeuf #apéro #belote #jaunededamas #untrainpourpau #kohlanta  
  
Pour autant, on bosse fort aussi. Chez Wyll, on est capable d’utiliser le système Docker Prune 🐳 (même si elle n’est pas mûre), ou encore de transférer son enregistrement de nom de domaine existant vers Amazon Route 53 sans perturber son trafic Web existant (ni la Route 66 d’ailleurs).  
  
Wyll intervient sur toute la chaîne du DevOps avec une approche de bout-en-bout depuis la phase amont avec la réalisation de POCs, en passant par la gestion de projet en mode Agile et le développement applicatif (backend, frontend, fullstack et Big Data) jusqu’à l’automatisation de tests, d'automatisation de l’intégration et du déploiement ainsi que les phases d’opérabilité (OPS) et de dématérialisation des infrastructures (Infra As A Code & Cloud).

About FDC Aéro Composites
-------------------------

FDC manufactures composite parts & complex assemblies (structures, radomes & interiors), mainly for the aerospace industry. FDC can Aldo offer its expertise in other sectors with high technical requirements, such as the Clean Tech industry.  
  
Located in the Montreal Canada area, our main manufacturing techniques are, Pre-Preg (in and out of autoclave), RTM, infusion (VARTM), CNC machining, assembly, and paint.  
  
FDC can take on « Turn-Key Projects » and develop fully customizable solutions when required.  
  
FDC has developed new innovative and cost-effective composite configurations for aircraft interiors.  
  
It has also invested to develop advanced composite configurations for aerostructures, including radomes. All types of fibres & resin systems are used.  
  
Its Value Added includes, design, reverse engineering, prototyping, testing, R&D, tooling, certification, integration of non composite elements, CNC machining, complete assembly, and painting.  
  
FDC is proud of its employees, their dedication, and their ability to innovate, manage complex programs and offer a high level of quality and service to its worldwide customers.  
  
FDC is part of the aerospace bt2i Group. Based in France, the Group, has over 700 employees specialized in metallic (machining & sheet metal) and composite aircraft parts manufacturing. The Group has plants in France, Tunisia, Canada & offices in the USA. The North American office and plant are in the greater Montreal (Canada) area.

What services does Flexe offer for e-commerce businesses?

Flexe provides a comprehensive suite of services tailored for e-commerce businesses, including on-demand warehousing, fulfillment, and last-mile delivery solutions. Their technology-driven platform allows retailers to scale their logistics operations flexibly, ensuring that they can meet fluctuating demand without the burden of long-term contracts or fixed costs.

How does Flexe's open logistics network work?

Flexe's open logistics network connects retailers and brands with a vast array of warehousing and fulfillment partners across the country. This network allows businesses to find the right logistics solutions based on their specific needs, such as location, capacity, and service level. By leveraging this network, companies can optimize their supply chain and reduce shipping times, ultimately enhancing customer satisfaction.

What industries does Flexe support?

Flexe supports a wide range of industries, including retail, consumer goods, fashion, electronics, and health and beauty. Their flexible logistics solutions are designed to cater to the unique challenges faced by these industries, such as seasonal demand fluctuations and the need for rapid fulfillment to meet customer expectations.

Can Flexe help with returns management?

Yes, Flexe offers returns management solutions that streamline the process for e-commerce businesses. Their platform allows retailers to efficiently handle returns, ensuring that products are processed quickly and accurately. This not only improves operational efficiency but also enhances the customer experience by providing clear return policies and faster refunds.

What are the benefits of using Flexe's elastic economic model?

Flexe's elastic economic model provides businesses with the flexibility to adjust their logistics costs based on actual usage rather than fixed contracts. This means that companies can scale their operations up or down in response to demand fluctuations, reducing overhead costs and minimizing risk. This model is particularly beneficial for seasonal businesses or those experiencing rapid growth.

How does Flexe ensure the security of my inventory?

Flexe takes inventory security seriously and employs multiple measures to protect your goods. Their partner warehouses are equipped with advanced security systems, including surveillance cameras, access controls, and inventory tracking technology. Additionally, Flexe conducts regular audits and assessments of their partners to ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices for inventory management.

### Frequently Asked Questions about XTN

What services does XTN Cognitive Security offer to protect against digital fraud?

XTN Cognitive Security specializes in a range of services designed to protect digital businesses from fraud and security threats. Our offerings include fraud protection and prevention solutions that leverage advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and machine learning. We focus on behavioral analysis and behavioral biometrics to assess user genuineness, ensuring that legitimate users can access services seamlessly while preventing unauthorized access and fraudulent activities.

How does XTN use artificial intelligence in its fraud prevention solutions?

XTN employs artificial intelligence to enhance its fraud prevention capabilities by analyzing vast amounts of user data in real-time. Our AI algorithms identify patterns and anomalies in user behavior, allowing us to detect potential fraud before it occurs. This proactive approach not only helps in mitigating risks but also ensures a frictionless user experience, as legitimate users are less likely to face unnecessary hurdles during authentication.

What industries does XTN Cognitive Security serve?

XTN Cognitive Security serves a diverse range of industries that require robust fraud protection and security measures. Our primary focus is on sectors such as finance, e-commerce, and mobile applications, where the risk of fraud is particularly high. By tailoring our solutions to meet the specific needs of each industry, we help businesses safeguard their digital assets and maintain the trust of their customers.

Can XTN's solutions be integrated into existing systems?

Yes, XTN Cognitive Security's solutions are designed to be easily integrated into existing systems and workflows. We understand that businesses often have established processes, and our technology is built to complement and enhance these systems without causing disruption. Our team works closely with clients to ensure a smooth integration process, allowing them to benefit from our advanced fraud protection capabilities quickly.

What is behavioral biometrics and how does it help in fraud prevention?

Behavioral biometrics is a technology that analyzes patterns in user behavior, such as typing speed, mouse movements, and navigation habits, to create a unique profile for each user. XTN Cognitive Security utilizes behavioral biometrics to differentiate between legitimate users and potential fraudsters. By continuously monitoring these behaviors, our solutions can detect anomalies that may indicate fraudulent activity, thereby enhancing security while maintaining a seamless user experience.

How does XTN ensure a frictionless user experience while preventing fraud?

At XTN Cognitive Security, we prioritize user experience alongside security. Our solutions are designed to operate in the background, using advanced algorithms to assess user behavior without interrupting the user journey. By implementing risk evaluation techniques that adapt to individual user profiles, we can minimize friction during authentication processes. This means that legitimate users can access services quickly and easily, while potential threats are identified and mitigated effectively.

ReCept Pharmacy has a rich tradition of delivering specialty patient care within the community it has served for over 40 years. At our core is the fundamental belief that face-to-face patient interaction significantly improves overall care, retention, compliance and outcomes. This interaction includes, but is not limited to, medical management, clinical instruction, benefit investigation and financial assistance. ReCept has built an exceptional service offering that incorporates two major business models as part of its expanding footprint. ReCept’s Specialty Pharmacy business which is driven through our “ReCept”- branded pharmacies and our Specialty Pharmacy Management Services that assists in the development and ultimate provision of management services to physician, clinic and hospital-owned pharmacies. For additional information on ReCept Pharmacy LP please visit our website at: www.receptrx.com . With our reputation for delivering outstanding customer service and our clinical education and monitoring programs, our mission is to continue to provide our customers with valued, trusted and uncomplicated pharmacy experience.

About Country Music Association (CMA)
-------------------------------------

Founded in 1958, the Country Music Association (CMA) is the premier membership trade association of the Country Music industry. Representing professionals making a living in Country Music globally, the organization serves as a critical resource of support and information, honors excellence in the genre, and provides a forum for industry leadership. CMA is dedicated to expanding Country Music around the world through a number of core programs and initiatives including the organization's three annual television properties—the CMA Awards, "CMA Fest" and "CMA Country Christmas," all of which air on ABC. The organization's philanthropic arm, the CMA Foundation, works tirelessly to provide equitable access to music education in order to create impactful change for students and teachers across the United States.  
  
Visit CMAmember.com to learn more about becoming a member. Visit CMAworld.com for more info about the association.

Founded in 2019, The Geyser Group believes in doing well by doing good and are uncompromising in return expectations. We are currently expanding into new, growing markets and focus on today’s most profitable and sustainable submarkets. Our process involves us identifying underserved customers in the real estate market, understanding their needs, and delivering products that represent a fair exchange of value for all involved. Resulting developments include flex offices for nontraditional commercial tenants, transit oriented multifamily developments, residential townhomes, and conservation-oriented land plays.

About Media Assembly
--------------------

Ad Age's 2018 Media Agency of the YearAssembly is a full-service agency backed by the creative heritage of parent company MDC Partners (NASDAQ: MDCA). At Assembly, we’re relentless in the pursuit of “why?” An agency built for the digital age, we achieve this through a blend of media arts + sciences. Assembly is a technology company with a top-flight data stack making ideas bigger through media. We pride ourselves on four key values including a commitment to full transparency that rejects ethical malpractices that have developed industry-wide. A relentless belief in placing data analysis at the core of what drives our culture of media science. A rebellious nature, with technology at the center of our offering and not a legacy media process for a by gone era. Along with a commitment to delivering artful and enduring work that creates lasting relationships with our clients and produces campaigns that resonate with their consumers. As our name suggests, we are a talented group of assemblers – people with a passion for building brands with far-ranging expertise stretching beyond what you might be accustomed to at other agencies. This includes a former rocket scientist, strategists from all walks of life, designers, data engineers, anthropologists and folks passionate about media execution. Everyone at our firm is expected to punch above their job title because everyone here is on a mission. People here don’t just believe they work at an ad agency. They understand that the world is changing and that they are a new breed of advertising technologist for a new era of communication. Assembly currently has a team of approximately 500 people with offices in New York, Los Angeles, Detroit and Austin, Texas.

About The Bernard Garrett Sr. Foundation
----------------------------------------

The Bernard Garrett Sr. Foundation was established to continue the legacy of economic freedom through advancing financial literacy and opportunity for African-Americans. Bernard Garrett Sr was the first African-American man to build a banking and real estate empire during the height of the racial divide in America. He built a legacy that continues to inspire today. There are many great African-American entrepreneurs, owners, developers, financiers, and investors waiting for their potential to be tapped.  
  
In the United States, 44 million African-Americans account for 13% of the U.S. population and have a significant impact on the economy, with $1.2 trillion in annual purchases. With a 38% financial literacy rate, financial well-being of African-Americans lags that of the U.S. population as a whole. The reasons for these gaps are complex, but one area of importance in addressing them is increased financial literacy, as well as increased opportunity in finance. We believe that partnering with the best organizations - that bring together resources, expertise, and vision – can identify issues, find answers, and drive change.  
  
Our Mission:  
Within a generation, lift African-American financial literacy rates from 38% to 50%.  
Within a generation, increase African-American employment in finance.  
Within a generation, see African-Americans create generational wealth.

About Society For American Baseball Research (SABR)
---------------------------------------------------

If you're interested in baseball — writing about it, reading about it, talking about it — there's a place for you in the Society for American Baseball Research.  
  
SABR was formed in 1971 in Cooperstown, New York, with the mission of fostering the research and dissemination of the history and record of the game. Our members include everyone from academics to professional sportswriters to amateur historians and statisticians to students and casual fans who merely enjoy reading about baseball history and occasionally gathering with other members to talk baseball.  
  
SABR members have a variety of interests, and this is reflected in the diversity of its research committees. There are more than two dozen groups devoted to the study of a specific area related to the game — from Baseball and the Arts to Statistical Analysis to the Deadball Era to Women in Baseball. In addition, many SABR members meet formally and informally in regional chapters throughout the year and hundreds come together for the annual national convention, the organization's premier event. These meetings often include panel discussions with former major league players and research presentations by members.  
  
Most of all, SABR members love talking baseball with like-minded friends. What unites them all is an interest in the game and joy in learning more about it.  
  
Learn more or join at SABR.org.

Since its inception in 1991, SOMOS' team of experienced senior management consulting & IT professionals have provided solutions that address the needs of technology and business-based organizations. SOMOS operates as the Ottawa base for its parent company, Smart Employee Benefits Inc. ("SEB"). As part of SEB’s Technology Solutions & Services Division, SOMOS brings additional value to existing clients, particularly in providing software, solutions & services in healthcare & supply chain solutions. The Technology Division also operates as a system integrator to the Health Benefits Division and to other clients.  
  
SOMOS and its partners and subsidiaries (Maplesoft Group, Paradigm Consulting Group, Inforica, QLogitek, Antian Professional Services) provide ICT professional consulting services, with specialty practices such as PRINCE2® training & consulting, hosted supply chain solutions & BizTalk services, BI, PeopleSoft, ERP, MS Dynamics CRM®, ITSM tools & consulting.  
  
Our clients choose SOMOS as their partner for the delivery of a wide array of consultants & subject matter experts, including the following specializations:  
\- Project, Program & Portfolio Management  
\- Information Technology/Information Management  
\- Security  
\- Access to Information & Privacy (ATIP)  
\- Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)  
\- SOMOS Software as a Service (SaaS)  
  
As an Accredited Training Organization (ATO) and a Accredited Consulting Organization (ACO -through subsidiary Paradigm Consulting), SOMOS provides training & consulting in PRINCE2, MSP, MoP and Managing Benefits.  
  
SOMOS has experience in successfully embedding PRINCE2 into government organizations: let us help you find a clear path to success.

About TV Globo
--------------

Produzimos conteúdo para TV aberta, TV fechada, Internet e outras mídias. Somos líderes de mercado nas principais categorias de sites de Internet: notícias, esportes, novelas.  
  
Desde nossa criação, em 26 de abril de 1965, a trajetória da Globo foi guiada por um sonho: tornar-se uma cadeia nacional de TV, cobrindo todo o território brasileiro. Mais de 45 anos depois, essa jornada – que coincide com o próprio progresso tecnológico e com a história da TV no Brasil – mostra que o sonho virou realidade. Na verdade, a realidade é, hoje, ainda maior que o sonho, incluindo diversas plataformas que alcançam o público aonde quer que ele vá.  
  
Sustentar o título de uma das maiores redes de televisão do mundo só é possível com muito trabalho, profissionalismo, investimento em qualidade e criatividade. O maior desafio é preservar a confiança de milhões de espectadores que assistem diariamente à programação da TV Globo (com link) no Brasil e no mundo.  
  
Atualmente, cobrimos 98,44% do território nacional, através das nossas Emissoras e Afiliadas, atingindo 5.482 municípios e 99,50% da população.  
  
Somos a maior rede de televisão do Brasil. Por trás de todo esse sucesso, está uma equipe de 12 mil funcionários.

Our services include but are not limited to marketing the institutions and their programs, admissions, student finance, student advising, human resources and communication, legal and compliance, finance and accounting, strategy and advanced analytics, and information technology.  
  
KHE has been a pioneer in higher education, using technology and learning science to expand educational access and improve outcomes for the students and partners it supports. In 2001, it helped launch Kaplan University’s foray into the emerging world of online higher education with just 34 students and a handful of degree options. In 2018, Kaplan University was acquired by Purdue University and as Purdue University Global (Purdue Global), is delivering on Purdue’s land grant mission in the 21st century. FiRE+iCE features a diverse menu that includes Italian, American, Latin, and Asian cuisines. Our create-your-own meal concept allows guests to choose from a wide array of fresh ingredients, ensuring a personalized dining experience.

Can I host a tour group at FiRE+iCE?

Absolutely! FiRE+iCE welcomes tour groups and can accommodate large parties. We offer special group menus and arrangements to ensure a memorable dining experience for your group. Please contact us in advance to discuss your needs.

What should I do if I have a special dietary requirement?

At FiRE+iCE, we strive to accommodate all dietary needs. Please inform your server of any special requirements when you arrive, and our team will assist you in selecting suitable ingredients and meal options.

E-filliate partners with large-scale retailers to launch bankable, scalable mobile accessories programs.

Stores are under immense pressure to do more with a smaller team and maximize sales opportunities from reduced traffic. To stay solvent, stores must now operate at maximum efficiency, make smarter decisions, and agilely respond to risks and opportunities.  
  
That’s where Blueday helps. Using the power of AI, Blueday crunches a retailer’s troves of data in real-time and finds the relevant patterns to drive action at the speed and detail of retail. This creates a powerful, data-driven approach to planning, execution, and optimization that’s tailored to each store and responsive to changing conditions.  
  
Trusted by over 50,000 users, across 5,000 stores around the globe, the Blueday Store Performance System enables stores to be more efficient, make smarter decisions, and agilely adjust to risks and opportunities. The results – time savings, less wasted efforts, maximum usage of labor assets, improvements in sales efficiency, and a path to long term success.  
  
With your system live as soon as you provide your data, Blueday is the solution your stores need now to succeed in the new retail landscape.

About Team.blue Denmark
-----------------------

team.blue is a parent company for a number of Cloud and hosting brands: Wannafind, ScanNet, Curanet, Simply.com, Cloud.dk, SmartWeb and DanDomain.  
  
Via these 7 specialist brands, team.blue develops, manages and services professional hosting and cloud solutions for small-scale and medium-scale companies.  
  
Because each of our brands is aimed at a particular market segment, we can provide the hosting solution that creates value for clients and their business - whether they require a webshop, a domain name or a customised palette of hosting solutions, which they can then resell in their own name.  
  
Overall, team.blue serves more than 250,000 private and corporate customers, and over almost two decades have demonstrated stable growth in terms of both turnover and revenue.  
  
To sustain that trust we always make sure we have the right competencies and certifications in place. For example, we are one of the few hosting companies in Denmark to be ISO 27001-certified.  
  
We also make sure we provide our staff with the best conditions we can. That is the only way we can provide hosting solutions that stand out from the crowd.

About Spirax-Sarco Engineering plc
----------------------------------

Spirax-Sarco Engineering plc is a world-leading thermal energy management and niche pumping group. The Company comprises three specialist engineering businesses: Steam Specialties (Spirax Sarco and Gestra), for the control and management of industrial steam systems; Electric Thermal Solutions (Chromalox and Thermocoax), for advanced electrical process heating and temperature management solutions; and Watson-Marlow, for the control and management of industrial fluid paths. Our purpose is to create sustainable value for all our stakeholders as we engineer a more efficient, safer and sustainable world.Through a global network of operating companies and sales offices in nearly 70 countries worldwide we directly serve over 110,000 customers, providing them with the thermal energy and pumping solutions required for the manufacture of a wide variety of products used around the world every day. For example, our steam solutions are used in the food industry for blanching, baking, packaging, sterilising and cleaning, while our pumps and associated fluid path equipment are used in the pharmaceutical industry during the development and production of life-saving medicines. Through the application of our expertise we provide customers with bespoke engineered solutions that deliver energy and water savings, reduced emissions, increased process efficiency and product quality, as well as improved health, safety and regulatory compliance.We employ over 8,000 diverse, knowledgeable and skilled people in a wide variety of roles from technical engineering to product development, manufacturing to technical sales, marketing to HR. Wherever we operate in the world, our employees share the same Company values of: Customer Focus, Excellence, Respect, Integrity, Safety and Collaboration. These values shape our culture and provide the foundation for everything we do.Our shares have been listed on the London Stock Exchange since 1959 and we are a constituent of the FTSE 100 index.

What types of industries does Spirax-Sarco Engineering support?

Spirax-Sarco Engineering serves a wide range of industries including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, oil and gas, energy, and manufacturing. Our solutions are tailored to meet the specific thermal energy management needs of each sector, ensuring efficiency and compliance with industry standards.

How can Spirax-Sarco Engineering help improve energy efficiency in my facility?

We offer a comprehensive range of services aimed at enhancing energy efficiency, including system audits, process heating solutions, and steam system optimization. Our expert team can analyze your current operations and recommend tailored solutions that reduce energy consumption, lower emissions, and ultimately decrease operating costs.

What is the process for obtaining a custom solution from Spirax-Sarco Engineering?

To obtain a custom solution, you can start by contacting our sales team or filling out an inquiry form on our website. We will then schedule a consultation to understand your specific needs, followed by a detailed assessment of your current systems. Based on this analysis, we will design a tailored solution that may include system design, fabrication, installation, and ongoing maintenance.

What types of maintenance services does Spirax-Sarco Engineering provide?

We provide a variety of maintenance services including routine inspections, troubleshooting, and emergency repairs for steam and thermal energy systems. Our maintenance programs are designed to ensure optimal performance, extend equipment lifespan, and minimize downtime, allowing your operations to run smoothly and efficiently.

Can Spirax-Sarco Engineering assist with the installation and commissioning of new systems?

Yes, we offer comprehensive installation and commissioning services for all our products and systems. Our experienced engineers will oversee the entire process, ensuring that everything is installed correctly and functions as intended. We also provide training for your staff to ensure they are familiar with the new systems and can operate them safely and efficiently.

What are the benefits of using Spirax-Sarco Engineering's steam specialties?

Our steam specialties are designed to enhance process efficiency, improve safety, and reduce energy costs. By utilizing our advanced steam management solutions, you can achieve better control over your processes, minimize steam losses, and ensure compliance with environmental regulations. This leads to increased productivity and significant cost savings in the long run.

Those three businesses include: Plaxo, focused on delivering on the vision of a truly smart, socially-aware, and pervasive address book; the Social Technologies Group (STG), created after the acquisition to lead address book, identity, and social strategies for all of Comcast; and Tunerfish , a new social entertainment internal startup, incubated in STG.

What is Plaxo and what services does it offer?

Plaxo is a web-based service that provides users with a smart address book, enabling them to manage and synchronize their contacts across various platforms. Founded in 2002, Plaxo helps users keep their contact information up to date by automatically syncing data from social networks, email accounts, and other sources. Additionally, Plaxo offers features for sharing and organizing contacts, making it easier for users to connect with friends, family, and colleagues.

How does Plaxo's smart address book work?

Plaxo's smart address book aggregates contact information from multiple sources, including social media profiles, email accounts, and other online platforms. When a user adds or updates a contact, Plaxo automatically syncs this information across all connected accounts, ensuring that users always have the most current contact details. This feature eliminates the hassle of manually updating contact information and helps users maintain a comprehensive and organized address book.

Can I access my Plaxo account from multiple devices?

Yes, Plaxo is designed to be accessible from any device with an internet connection. Users can log in to their Plaxo account from desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones. The platform's cloud-based nature ensures that all contact information is synchronized in real-time, allowing users to access their address book and manage contacts seamlessly across different devices.

What industries does Plaxo support?

Plaxo primarily serves individuals and professionals across various industries who need efficient contact management solutions. This includes business professionals, sales teams, and anyone who relies on maintaining a large network of contacts. Additionally, Plaxo's integration with social media platforms makes it valuable for marketers and social media managers looking to streamline their communication and networking efforts.

Is my data secure with Plaxo?

Plaxo takes data security seriously and employs industry-standard measures to protect user information. This includes encryption for data in transit and at rest, as well as regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities. Users are also encouraged to use strong passwords and enable two-factor authentication for added security. Plaxo is committed to maintaining the privacy and security of its users' data.

How can I get support if I encounter issues with my Plaxo account?

If you encounter any issues with your Plaxo account, you can access the support section on the Plaxo website, which provides a variety of resources, including FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and contact information for customer support. Users can also reach out to Plaxo's support team via email or through the help center for personalized assistance with their inquiries or technical issues.

Our pilots average over 3,000 individual hours of tactical fighter time, are former Weapons School Instructors or Test Pilots, and have extensive civilian experience as well. By integrating these advanced technologies, we help our clients unlock new efficiencies and drive innovation within their organizations.

AustinCSI supports agile transformation by providing tailored coaching and training programs that empower teams to adopt agile methodologies effectively. Our goal is to help businesses enhance their delivery capabilities and achieve better outcomes through agile practices.

TGC Group is a full-service Development, Investment and Hospitality Management company focused on the acquisition, syndication, development of restaurant, hospitality, commercial and multi-family properties throughout the country. TGC doesn’t just develop and build “projects”, we primarily develop confidence and relationships with our lenders, investment partners, franchise partners, vendors, communities in which we exist and most importantly, the GUESTS who stay in our properties.  
  
TGC Development Group functions as a preferred developer for its clients and through its subsidiary holding companies and strategic partnerships, it owns and operates franchised restaurant and hotel locations nationwide. We are constantly reviewing and analyzing business and investment opportunities that can add value and provide long term success and returns to our holding companies and investment partners.  
  
TGC Hospitality Management is a Hospitality Management company founded in 2015 and is made up of team members with a combined 40 years of property and asset management. Community is one of the core focus’ of our teams’ vision and culture. When we enter a community to operate hotels, we do not take the responsibility of being a “good neighbor” lightly. TGC works with the local municipalities, citizens, non-profit organizations and neighboring businesses to add value by being a “giver” not a “taker”. Our objective is to open the minds and hearts of our associates to be good citizens and to recognize our civic duty to be involved in enhancing the lives of others not just through intentions, but through actions.

How does TGC Group approach property development and investment?

TGC Group employs a comprehensive approach to property development and investment that includes thorough market analysis, strategic budgeting, and meticulous site selection. Our team collaborates closely with stakeholders throughout the entire process, from initial concept and design to construction management and pre-opening activities, ensuring that each project aligns with our clients' goals and market demands.

What services does TGC Group offer in hospitality management?

In hospitality management, TGC Group offers a full suite of services, including revenue management, brand compliance, training, and property-level accounting. We focus on enhancing operational efficiency and guest satisfaction, leveraging our extensive industry experience to optimize performance and drive profitability for our hospitality clients.

We manage all aspects of the renovation process, from initial planning and budgeting to contractor negotiations and final execution, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations.

What industries does TGC Group serve?

TGC Group serves a variety of industries, primarily focusing on hospitality, commercial real estate, and multi-family residential sectors. Our expertise extends to restaurant development, retail construction, and financial modeling, allowing us to cater to the unique needs of each industry while delivering exceptional results.

How does TGC Group ensure compliance with brand standards during development?

TGC Group places a strong emphasis on brand compliance throughout the development process. We work closely with brand representatives to understand their specific requirements and ensure that all aspects of the project, from design to construction and pre-opening, adhere to these standards. Our commitment to quality and attention to detail helps maintain brand integrity and enhances the overall guest experience.

What types of incubation equipment does Jamesway Chick Master Incubator Inc. offer?

Jamesway Chick Master Incubator Inc. provides a wide range of incubation equipment tailored for various poultry species, including chickens, turkeys, geese, and ducks. Our product line includes incubators, hatchers, and specialized ventilation systems designed to optimize hatching conditions and improve hatch rates. We also offer advanced automation solutions to streamline hatchery management.

How does Jamesway Chick Master Incubator Inc. ensure optimal conditions for hatching?

We utilize state-of-the-art HVAC and ventilation technologies to maintain precise temperature, humidity, and air circulation within our incubation systems. Our equipment is designed to create an ideal environment for embryos, ensuring consistent and reliable hatching results. Additionally, our automation solutions allow for real-time monitoring and adjustments to maintain optimal conditions throughout the incubation process.

What industries does Jamesway Chick Master Incubator Inc. serve?

Jamesway Chick Master Incubator Inc. primarily serves the poultry industry, focusing on hatcheries that produce chickens, turkeys, geese, and ducks. Our solutions are designed for both commercial and small-scale operations, providing the necessary equipment and technology to support efficient hatchery management and production. We also cater to research institutions and agricultural organizations involved in poultry breeding and development.

Can Jamesway Chick Master Incubator Inc. assist with hatchery management and consulting?

Yes, we offer consulting services to help hatchery operators optimize their processes and improve overall efficiency. Our team of experts can provide guidance on best practices for incubation, ventilation, and automation, as well as assist in the design and layout of hatchery facilities. We aim to empower our clients with the knowledge and tools needed to achieve successful hatching outcomes.

What support and training does Jamesway Chick Master Incubator Inc. provide for customers?

We are committed to supporting our customers through comprehensive training programs and ongoing technical assistance. Our training covers equipment operation, maintenance, and best practices for incubation and hatchery management. Additionally, our customer support team is available to assist with any technical inquiries or issues that may arise, ensuring that our clients can maximize the performance of their incubation systems.

How can I request a quote for incubation equipment from Jamesway Chick Master Incubator Inc.?

To request a quote for our incubation equipment, you can visit our website and fill out the contact form or directly reach out to our sales team via email or phone. Please provide details about your specific needs, including the type of poultry, scale of operation, and any particular features you are interested in. Our team will respond promptly with a tailored quote and additional information about our products and services.

At Born, we believe that effective brand content is essential for engaging audiences and building lasting relationships. Our approach involves understanding the client's brand identity, target audience, and market trends. We then create compelling narratives and visuals that resonate with the audience, ensuring that the content aligns with the overall marketing strategy and enhances brand visibility.

What industries does Born support?

Born serves a diverse range of industries including but not limited to technology, fashion, entertainment, and tourism. Our creative solutions are designed to cater to the specific needs and challenges of each industry, allowing us to deliver impactful marketing strategies that drive results and foster growth.

Can Born assist with event management and sponsorships?

Absolutely! Born has extensive experience in event management, from conceptualization to execution. We handle all aspects of events, including logistics, design, and promotion. Additionally, we can help secure sponsorships that align with your brand, ensuring that your event is well-supported and reaches a wider audience.

What is video mapping and how can it benefit my brand?

Video mapping is a creative projection technique that transforms surfaces into dynamic video displays. At Born, we utilize video mapping to create immersive experiences that captivate audiences. This innovative approach can enhance brand storytelling, attract attention at events, and create memorable interactions that leave a lasting impression on your audience.

How can I get started with Born's services?

Getting started with Born is easy! You can reach out to us through our website or contact us directly via email or phone. We will schedule an initial consultation to discuss your needs, goals, and how our services can best support your brand. Our team is dedicated to providing personalized solutions that align with your vision.

About Israel Biotech Fund
-------------------------

Israel Biotech Fund – Building the future of Israeli Biotech  
  
Israel Biotech Fund seeks high value returns by identifying and maximizing the success of therapeutic assets of Israel-based biotech companies.  
  
Based in Rehovot, Israel’s main Biotech hub, we invest exclusively in Biotech companies developing drugs at or near clinical stages.  
  
Our partners include two top-tier international pharmaceuticals companies, institutional investors, family offices and high net worth individuals.  
  
Our key asset is a unique team of 25 Venture Advisors, comprised of renowned industry leaders and professionals who, together with the fund’s managing partners, provide our portfolio companies with hands-on guidance and support.  
  
We don’t just invest in promising companies – we have the ability, experience and network required to identify the best opportunities and partner with our portfolio companies to help them go the distance.  
  
We provide our portfolio companies with the necessary resources for long-term sustainable growth. This approach enhances their value and the investor’s long-term capital appreciation, while strengthening Israel’s Biotech industry which increases investment opportunities.  
  
The biotechnology industry in Israel is growing with enormous potential and we are determined to realize its full potential and real value.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Israel Biotech Fund

What types of companies does Israel Biotech Fund invest in?

Israel Biotech Fund primarily invests in early to mid-stage biotechnology companies. We focus on innovative startups that are developing cutting-edge therapies, diagnostics, and medical technologies. Our portfolio includes companies working in areas such as oncology, neurology, immunology, and regenerative medicine, among others.

What services does Israel Biotech Fund provide to its portfolio companies?

In addition to financial investment, Israel Biotech Fund offers a range of support services to its portfolio companies. This includes strategic guidance, access to industry networks, assistance with regulatory affairs, and help in business development. We aim to leverage our expertise and connections to accelerate the growth and success of our investments.

How does Israel Biotech Fund evaluate potential investment opportunities?

Our evaluation process involves a thorough analysis of the scientific merit of the technology, the strength of the management team, market potential, and competitive landscape. We also consider the regulatory pathway and potential exit strategies. Our experienced team conducts due diligence to ensure that we invest in companies with a strong likelihood of success.

What industries does Israel Biotech Fund focus on?

Israel Biotech Fund focuses primarily on the biotechnology and life sciences industries. This includes sectors such as pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, and digital health. We are particularly interested in companies that are leveraging advanced technologies, such as genomics, artificial intelligence, and personalized medicine, to drive innovation.

Can startups apply for funding from Israel Biotech Fund directly?

Yes, startups can apply for funding directly through our website. We encourage innovative biotech companies to submit their business plans and proposals for consideration. Our team reviews submissions on a rolling basis and will reach out to promising candidates to discuss potential investment opportunities.

What is the geographic focus of Israel Biotech Fund's investments?

While Israel Biotech Fund is based in Israel and has a strong focus on Israeli biotech companies, we are open to exploring investment opportunities in other regions, particularly those that align with our strategic interests and expertise. We believe in fostering global collaborations that can enhance innovation and market reach.

About Pratt & Whitney AeroPower Rzeszów
---------------------------------------

Oficjalny profil Pratt & Whitney AeroPower Rzeszów.  
Projektujemy, produkujemy i serwisujemy, silniki pomocnicze APU. Działalność Pratt & Whitney AeroPower Rzeszów obejmuje przede wszystkim montaż nowych silników APU (Auxiliary Power Unit), remonty i naprawę silników APU oraz innych komponentów lotniczych. Ogromną dumą oraz przewagą nad innymi firmami branży lotniczej jest kompleksowość Pratt & Whitney AeroPower Rzeszów. Oprócz obszarów produkcji i remontów, P&W AP wyposażona jest we własne hamownie, dzięki czemu może prowadzić działalności we wszystkich obszarach – od projektowania nowych modeli, poprzez ich produkcję, aż do momentu testowania wyrobów na stanowiskach hamownianych.  
Współpracujemy z głównymi producentami płatowców takimi jak Boeing, Airbus czy Embraer, a w obsłudze serwisowej APU mamy ponad 70 linii lotniczych z całego świata, m.in. LOT, UNITED, Latam, British Airways, AirFrance i inne. W ostatnim czasie uruchomiliśmy dodatkowo serwis przekładni FDGS do silników z rodziny PW1000.  
Prowadzimy również działalność badawczo-rozwojową. Centrum Badawczo-Rozwojowe P&W to miejsce dla ludzi z technologiczną pasją. Tu pracujemy nad silnikami głównymi i pomocniczymi (APU) z rodziny Pratt & Whitney. CBR posiada nowoczesne biuro konstrukcyjne, pracownię prototypów, laboratorium materiałowe oraz hamownię eksperymentalną do testowania silników turbośmigłowych, turbowałowych oraz APU.  
Pratt & Whitney projektuje, produkuje i serwisuje najbardziej zaawansowane silniki lotnicze na świecie oraz pomocnicze jednostki zasilające APU (auxiliary power units) do samolotów cywilnych i wojskowych. Firma z główną siedzibą w East Hartford w Connecticut, zatrudnia 43 000 pracowników na całym świecie, a w 2019 roku osiągnęła sprzedaż netto w wysokości 21 miliardów dolarów. Pratt & Whitney jest jedną z czterech firm, które tworzą Raytheon Technologies Corporation.

About Abu Dhabi Digital Authority (ADDA)
----------------------------------------

The Abu Dhabi Digital Authority (ADDA) is a pivotal entity in the United Arab Emirates, dedicated to transforming government services through innovative digital solutions. Established in 2005 as a committee and formalized as a center in 2008, ADDA operates from its headquarters in the International Tower, Al Karamah Street, Abu Dhabi. Its primary mission is to advance the e-Government platform, ensuring that services are modern, efficient, and centered around the needs of citizens.  
  
ADDA serves a wide array of industries, including public administration, healthcare, education, and transportation, by implementing cutting-edge technologies such as cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and data analytics. These technologies enable the authority to streamline processes, enhance service delivery, and foster a more connected and responsive government ecosystem. By focusing on digital transformation initiatives, ADDA not only improves operational efficiency but also elevates the overall user experience for residents and businesses in Abu Dhabi.  
  
The authority is committed to developing a comprehensive digital infrastructure that supports various government entities in their transition to a fully integrated e-Government model. Through innovative products and services, such as mobile applications, online portals, and data-sharing platforms, ADDA empowers citizens to access essential services seamlessly. By prioritizing transparency, accessibility, and user engagement, the Abu Dhabi Digital Authority is at the forefront of creating a smart, sustainable, and citizen-centric future for the emirate.

What types of design materials does Willis offer?

Willis specializes in a wide range of premium design materials suitable for both interior and exterior applications. Our offerings include Solid Surface materials, Quartz, Sintered Stone, and Fenix. We curate these materials to meet the diverse needs of architects, designers, and fabricators, ensuring high-quality solutions for various design projects.

How does Willis support the design and fabrication communities?

At Willis, we believe in collaboration with multidisciplinary design and fabrication communities. We provide not only high-quality materials but also technical services and customer support to assist in the design and implementation processes. Our goal is to inspire and educate our partners, helping them to solve challenges and achieve their design visions effectively.

Can Willis assist with custom fabrication of materials?

Yes, Willis offers custom fabrication services to meet specific project requirements. Our experienced team works closely with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions. Whether it's cutting, shaping, or finishing materials, we ensure that the final product aligns perfectly with your design specifications.

What industries does Willis serve?

Willis serves a variety of industries, including commercial, residential, hospitality, and healthcare. Our diverse range of design materials and solutions are suitable for applications in these sectors, enabling us to cater to the unique demands of each industry while maintaining high standards of quality and innovation.

What is the process for sourcing materials through Willis?

Sourcing materials through Willis is a streamlined process. Clients can reach out to our sales team to discuss their specific needs, and we will guide them through our extensive catalog of curated materials. Our team can assist with selecting the right products, providing samples, and ensuring timely delivery to support your project timelines.

Does Willis provide training or educational resources for designers?

Absolutely! Willis is committed to educating our partners in the design community. We offer training sessions, workshops, and resources that cover the features and benefits of our materials, as well as best practices for their application. Our aim is to empower designers with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions and maximize the potential of our products in their projects.

With her unmistakable voice and unwavering commitment to artistic expression, Lang remains a seminal figure in the music industry.

About South Bend Controls
-------------------------

Products for aerospace, defense and commercial aircraft programs are comprised of D.C. Solenoids, Solenoid Valves, Proportional Flow Controls, Anti-ice Valves, Pressure Regulators, Quick Disconnects, Fill & Vent valves, Check Valves, Relief Valves and Squib-Actuated Valves.  
  
The Servoid® Valve is also well designed for aircraft applications. It is used primarily for fluid metering in mid-size engine systems to meter the supply of fuel and/or air. South Bend Controls also includes the intellectual property of the Futurecraft Corporation, a company with a long history of designing innovative space and aircraft products that SBC continues to build upon.  
  
Additional services are contract cleaning for space products and contract manufacturing of customer designs. SBC maintains FAA repair station certification to keep all of our components and the equipment they are installed on flying into the future.  
  
Our most well-known commercial products are in the medical field. Our proportional Servoid® valves allow proportional flow control in devices such as critical care ventilators, anesthesia controllers and sleep apnea equipment . Servoid® Valves offer high open loop accuracy, repeatability, durability and flexibility to meet your specific system needs. Additional applications of SBC proportional valves are in distributed power generation, turbine systems and fuel cells.  
  
Our solenoid-operated, Inert Isolation Valves are unsurpassed in control of highly aggressive fluids typically found in clinical chemistry, instrumentation, hemodialysis, and many bio-medical applications. The 2-way and 3-way valves have wetted surfaces made entirely of engineered materials such as PEEK, Ultem® (polyethermide), Radel® R, Viton®-GF or EPDM with FDA and UPS class VI approval. These valves withstand chemical attack by corrosive and biological fluids while remaining inert and maintaining the integrity of the fluid pathway.

About Lotte Chemical
--------------------

1976년에 설립된 롯데케미칼은 첨단석유화학기술을 토착화하고 꾸준한 기술개발에 주력하여 그 입지를 탄탄히 다지고 있습니다.  
  
롯데케미칼 여수, 대산, 울산 공장은 국내외 최고 규모를 자랑합니다. 올레핀, 방향족 사업과 같은 석유화학 기초원료 및 제품 생산은 물론 꾸준한 공장 증설과 사업 확장으로 원료에서 제품에 이르는 수직계열화를 이뤘습니다. 효율적인 공정을 통해 고품질의 제품을 생산하는 롯데케미칼의 대표제품으로는 에틸렌, HDPE, LDPE, LLDPE, PP, 기능성수지, EG, SM, PIA, PET 등이 있습니다. 또한, 대전에 위치한 롯데케미칼 연구소는 신제품 개발을 꾸준히 진행하며 국내석유화학 분야에서 입지를 확고히 하고 있습니다.  
롯데케미칼의 제품은 전 세계 152개 국가로 뻗어가고 있습니다. 롯데케미칼은 2009년 파키스탄 PTA, 2010년 영국 Artenius UK, Titan Chemical Corp. 인수로 더 많은 나라에 우수한 제품을 효율적으로 공급할 수 있게 되었습니다. 또한 국내외 영업활동을 활발히 하기 위해 중국 판매법인과 홍콩, 러시아, 미국에 해외지사를 설립하여 글로벌 경쟁력 강화에 더욱 박차를 가하고 있습니다.  
롯데케미칼은 아시아 최고 화학 기업으로서 삶의 가치 향상과 환경과의 조화를 생각하는 글로벌 화학기업이 되겠습니다.  
  
  
More than Chemistry  
  
Lotte Chemical is a global petrochemical company committed to advancing technologies that build a better world for all.  
  
Established in 1976, LOTTE CHEMICAL has been solidifying its position by localizing cutting-edge petrochemical technologies and concentrating its efforts on the steady development of technologies.

About Conceptus
---------------

Conceptus, Inc. is a leader in the design, development, and marketing of innovative solutions in women's healthcare.  
  
The Company manufactures and markets the Essure procedure, which was FDA approved in 2002 and is the first permanent birth control method that can be performed in the comfort of a physician's office in less than 10 minutes (average hysteroscopic time) without hormones, cutting, burning or the risks associated with general anesthesia or tubal ligation. Soft, flexible inserts are placed in a woman's fallopian tubes through the cervix without incisions. Over the next three months, the body forms a natural barrier around the micro-inserts to prevent sperm from reaching the egg. The Essure procedure is 99.95% effective based on one year of follow up with zero pregnancies reported in clinical trials, making it the most effective form of permanent birth control on the market. The procedure is covered by most insurance plans, and when it is performed in a doctor's office the cost to the patient may be as low as a simple co-pay.  
  
Three months after the Essure procedure, a doctor is able to perform an Essure Confirmation Test to confirm that the inserts are properly placed and the fallopian tubes are fully blocked, giving the patient reliance on Essure for permanent birth control. Essure has been proven and trusted by physicians since 2002, with nearly 500,000 women worldwide having undergone the Essure procedure.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Conceptus

Who is the CEO of Conceptus?

Mark Sieczkarek is the CEO of Conceptus. To contact Mark Sieczkarek email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
.

Who are the decision makers in Conceptus?

The decision makers in Conceptus are Joe Sharpe, Kim Tyndall, Lisa Corona, etc. Click to Find [Conceptus decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Conceptus&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What is the Essure procedure and how does it work?

The Essure procedure is a permanent birth control method that involves placing small, flexible coils into the fallopian tubes. Over time, these coils promote the growth of scar tissue, which blocks the tubes and prevents sperm from reaching the egg. The procedure is performed in a doctor's office and typically takes about 10-15 minutes. It is a non-surgical option that does not require general anesthesia, making it a convenient choice for many women.

What are the benefits of choosing Essure for permanent birth control?

Essure offers several benefits as a permanent birth control method. It is a non-surgical procedure, which means less recovery time and no incisions. It is also highly effective, with a success rate of over 99% in preventing pregnancy. Additionally, Essure does not require hormonal contraception, making it a suitable option for women who prefer to avoid hormones. Once the procedure is completed and confirmed with a follow-up test, women can enjoy peace of mind without the worry of unintended pregnancy.

Is the Essure procedure reversible?

No, the Essure procedure is designed to be a permanent form of birth control. While there are surgical options available to attempt reversal, they are not guaranteed to be successful. Women considering Essure should be confident in their decision to pursue permanent birth control, as it is intended for those who do not wish to have children in the future.

What types of healthcare providers can perform the Essure procedure?

The Essure procedure can be performed by a variety of healthcare providers, including obstetricians, gynecologists, and family medicine doctors who have received specific training in the procedure. It is important for patients to consult with their healthcare provider to determine if they are a good candidate for Essure and to ensure that the provider has the necessary experience and expertise.

What should I expect during the recovery period after the Essure procedure?

Recovery from the Essure procedure is generally quick. Most women can return to their normal activities within a day or two. Some may experience mild cramping or discomfort, which can usually be managed with over-the-counter pain relievers. It is important to follow your healthcare provider's post-procedure instructions and schedule a follow-up appointment to confirm that the procedure was successful and that the fallopian tubes are blocked.

What industries does Conceptus, Inc. support with its innovative healthcare solutions?

Conceptus, Inc. primarily supports the women's healthcare industry with its innovative solutions, particularly in the area of permanent birth control. The company focuses on developing and marketing products that enhance women's reproductive health and provide safe, effective options for family planning. By prioritizing women's health, Conceptus aims to improve healthcare outcomes and empower women to make informed choices about their reproductive futures.

Ray Fisher is a magnetic American actor who has captivated audiences around the world with his powerful performances and undeniable talent. Born and raised in Baltimore, Maryland, Fisher discovered his passion for acting at a young age. Fisher's journey in the entertainment industry began when he was cast in the groundbreaking play "Fetch Clay, Make Man" at the prestigious McCarter Theatre. It was here that he had the incredible opportunity to work under the direction of Oscar-winning actor and director, Des McAnuff. The play explored the real-life friendship between Muhammad Ali and Stepin Fetchit, and Fisher's portrayal of the legendary boxer earned him widespread acclaim.  
  
Following this success, Fisher made his way onto the silver screen with a supporting role in the critically acclaimed film "Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice." In the film, Fisher portrayed the iconic character of Victor Stone, also known as Cyborg. His gripping portrayal of a young man struggling to come to terms with his newfound powers garnered praise from both critics and audiences alike.  
  
Fisher's star continued to rise with his standout role in the highly anticipated superhero ensemble film, "Justice League." Directed by Zack Snyder, the film brought together some of the most iconic DC Comics characters, including Batman, Wonder Woman, and The Flash. As Cyborg, Fisher brought a depth and vulnerability to the character, adding layers of complexity to the film's narrative. His performance was hailed as one of the highlights of the film, proving that he had the ability to hold his own among a stellar cast.  
  
In addition to his work in the superhero genre, Fisher has demonstrated his versatility as an actor through his involvement in a variety of other projects. He showcased his dramatic range in the gripping crime thriller "True Detective," starring alongside acclaimed actors Mahershala Ali and Stephen Dorff. Fisher portrayed the character of Henry Hays, a young man grappling with the long-lasting effects of a powerful crime in his hometown. His nuanced performance earned him critical acclaim and further solidified his status as an actor to watch.  
  
Beyond his undeniable talent, Fisher has also become known for his advocacy for diversity and equality in the entertainment industry. He has been a vocal supporter of the #BlackLivesMatter movement and has used his platform to speak out against systemic racism and injustice. Fisher has been at the forefront of pushing for inclusivity and representation both in front of and behind the camera, using his influence to ensure that more diverse stories are being told.  
  
With his magnetic presence, undeniable talent, and unwavering dedication to his craft, Ray Fisher is undoubtedly an actor on the rise. Whether he is portraying a superhero, a troubled young man, or a historical figure, Fisher brings an authenticity and depth to each role he takes on. It is clear that he is not only a performer but also an advocate for change in the entertainment industry. As he continues to push boundaries and break barriers, Fisher is poised to make a profound impact on the world of film and inspire generations to come.

About Anil L

Anil L. is an accomplished Independent Consultant at Regulatory and CMC Services LLC, where he leverages his extensive biopharma experience to provide strategic guidance in Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) as well as regulatory affairs. With a robust background in academia and industry, Anil has developed a unique agility that allows him to navigate complex challenges and deliver actionable solutions effectively. His expertise spans a variety of therapeutic areas, particularly in Ophthalmology and Central Nervous System (CNS) disorders, as well as cutting-edge modalities such as biologics, cell therapy, and gene therapy.  
  
Currently, Anil is deeply involved in pivotal projects, including a comprehensive readiness assessment for a sponsor’s Module 3, along with the evaluation of a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization's (CDMO) Master File and Regulatory Support File (RSF) for a Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designated autologous, ex-vivo lentiviral vector modified T-Cell Receptor (TCR-T) oncology program. This initiative targets solid tumors and underscores Anil’s commitment to advancing innovative therapies through meticulous regulatory strategy and CMC guidance. His role also encompasses preclinical support, INTERACT meetings, and pre-Investigational New Drug (IND) engagements, ensuring that clients are well-prepared for regulatory submissions.  
  
Anil's skill set is further enhanced by his proficiency in mitigation strategies, regulatory guidelines, quality assurance, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP). His experience with Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and quality auditing complements his strong foundation in protein chemistry, making him a valuable asset in the biopharmaceutical landscape. Anil's dedication to execution and delivery positions him as a trusted advisor, helping clients navigate the complexities of drug development and regulatory compliance.
