About Pretty Lake Camp
----------------------

Since 1916, Pretty Lake Camp, a non-profit community organization, has provided a cost-free summer camp experience to over 50,000 at-risk youth from Kalamazoo County. Throughout the years, we have enriched the lives of thousands of youth by offering a safe, structured and encouraging environment in a natural setting. We accommodate over 800 children each summer.  
  
Through the financial support of generous individuals and organizations, we provide everything that campers need during their session at camp – clothes, toiletries, bedding, towels, food, transportation to and from camp, and activities – at no cost to the camper or their family or caregiver. Our focus is to assist in the development of campers by teaching life skills and helping campers cope with life’s challenges.  
  
Our Mission  
Pretty Lake’s mission is to provide adventure education and outdoor experiences that change lives and improve the community. We do this by:  
  
Providing a free summer camp for the youth most likely to benefit from the opportunity  
Offering a wide range of customized adventure experiences for youth and adults  
Promoting opportunities to experience, appreciate and steward our environment  
Making our unique natural environment and facilities available for the community to experience and enjoy  
  
Our Vision  
Pretty Lake Camp will be a premier youth-serving organization through camping services. We will grow happy, resilient, strong children through compassionate and healthy relationships with caring mentors.  
  
Our Future  
We are committed to strengthening ourselves as the “community’s camp” – a year-round resource for our campers, families, schools, retreat guests and the community at large. True to our founder, Edward B. Desenberg, the core of the organization will be the on-going operation and continuous improvement of all of our programs.

About Trans Ova Genetics
------------------------

Trans Ova Genetics provides industry-leading reproductive technologies and expertise to cattle breeders through a unique professional services team that works closely with clients to understand their breeding goals, and ultimately help clients advance and extend superior genetics. Trans Ova Genetics understands the process that will help multiply a herd’s genetic success. Reproductive technologies such as embryo transfer, in-vitro fertilization (IVF), sexed-semen, genetic preservation and cloning are considered the reproductive “tools” available for breeders looking to achieve specific breeding and reproductive goals. Internationally recognized as a source of superior animal husbandry and reproductive expertise, Trans Ova Genetics offers an integrated system of regional centers, satellite stations and on-farm application of reproductive technologies. From veterinarians and embryologists, to animal caretakers and client service representatives, each location and its team share a consistent commitment to client service that can multiply the results within any breeding program. On-going research and applied science allows Trans Ova Genetics to develop and implement new technologies that will help move the science of bovine genetic improvement forward. Trans Ova is dedicated to meeting the requirements of their customers and to continual improvement.

We are a full-service renewable energy company offering design and installation services in Western North Carolina and Upstate South Carolina. Our team has over 45 years of combined experience helping residences, businesses, and government go solar.

Our Sort, Containment & Rework services begin with a thorough assessment of your current processes and product quality issues. Our team works on-site to implement these solutions efficiently, ensuring minimal disruption to your operations.

How does Proxemics Consulting gather and utilize data for feedback?

We employ a systematic approach to Data Collection & Feedback, utilizing both quantitative and qualitative methods. Our team collects data through direct observations, surveys, and performance metrics. This information is then analyzed to identify trends, areas for improvement, and actionable insights. We provide our clients with detailed reports and recommendations to help them make informed decisions that enhance supplier relationships and profitability.

About Tom Sacks

Tom Sachs is an American contemporary artist known for his innovative sculptures and installations that often feature unexpected materials and methods of production. Born in 1966 in New York City, Sachs has gained recognition for his work which blurs the lines between art and everyday life, embracing the concept of "bricolage" or creating from what is readily available. His work, which often evokes themes of consumerism, space exploration, and popular culture, has been exhibited in prestigious museums and galleries around the world.  
  
One of Sachs' most well-known works is "NASA Space Program," a series of sculptures and installations that re-imagine the iconic imagery of space exploration. Using found and repurposed materials, Sachs creates intricate and detailed models of spacecraft, lunar modules, and astronaut suits, imbuing the objects with a sense of wonder and nostalgia. His "Space Program" has been exhibited at the Gagosian Gallery in New York, the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art, and the Park Avenue Armory, among others.  
  
Sachs' fascination with the idea of exploration and discovery is also evident in his "Tea Ceremony" series, in which he reinterprets the traditional Japanese tea ceremony using everyday objects such as power tools, plywood, and duct tape. This subversion of a centuries-old ritual with contemporary, utilitarian materials challenges notions of high and low culture, and questions the value and purpose of art itself.  
  
In addition to his sculptural work, Sachs has also made a name for himself with his "Studios" series, in which he creates life-size replicas of his own workspace, complete with tools, materials, and personal effects. These meticulous reconstructions offer a glimpse into Sachs' creative process, as well as a commentary on the nature of artistic production and the boundaries between art and life. His "Studio" installations have been exhibited at the Yerba Buena Center for the Arts in San Francisco, the Astrup Fearnley Museum in Oslo, and the Lever House in New York City.  
  
Sachs' work has been celebrated for its ability to provoke thought and spark conversations about the role of art in contemporary society. By blurring the lines between high and low culture, by repurposing everyday materials into works of art, and by challenging traditional notions of artistic production, Sachs has positioned himself as a leading figure in the contemporary art world.  
  
Throughout his career, Sachs has continued to push the boundaries of artistic expression, experimenting with new materials and methods, while maintaining a strong sense of craftsmanship and attention to detail. His ability to meld elements of pop culture, consumerism, and technology into his work has resonated with audiences around the world, earning him a devoted following and critical acclaim.  
  
With his unorthodox approach to making art and his ability to create thought-provoking, immersive experiences, Tom Sachs has solidified his place as one of the most influential and innovative artists of his generation. His work continues to challenge and inspire, inviting viewers to see the world in new and unexpected ways.

Rice was committed to ensuring that taxpayer dollars were used wisely and effectively, and he consistently sought out opportunities to streamline government operations and eliminate unnecessary spending.

South Carolina is home to numerous military installations, and Rice recognized the importance of providing strong support for the men and women in uniform who serve and sacrifice for their nation. He advocated for policies that would enhance military readiness, improve veterans' healthcare, and expand opportunities for military families, recognizing their vital contributions to the nation's defense.  
  
Tom Rice's tenure as a United States Representative was marked by a steadfast commitment to addressing the pressing issues facing his constituents and the nation. He brought to his role a strong understanding of the law, a dedication to fiscal responsibility, and a passion for advocating on behalf of the people he served. His work in Congress reflected his unwavering commitment to promoting economic growth, supporting small businesses, and improving infrastructure, all while ensuring the needs of the military and veterans were addressed. United Engines is a global manufacturer and service provider of transmissions, generators, and diesel and truck engines. Partnering with Detroit, MTU, Allison, and Isuzu Diesel, United Engines is a one-stop depot for genuine manufactured engine parts and services. All of United Engine’s technicians are factory-trained and certified.  
  
United Engines takes pride in meeting customers’ expectations by having the necessary parts in stock and keeping their turnaround time to a minimum, helping vehicles get back on the road and performing optimally.  
  
United Engines is a multi-year gold recipient of the Allison PRP Program and is headquartered in Oklahoma City.

About Anchor Packaging
----------------------

Anchor Packaging is one of North America’s largest thermoform packaging producers and is best known for its award-winning foodservice product designs and custom package capabilities. Founded in 1963, Anchor Packaging LLC has developed innovative solutions to packaging challenges for nearly 60 years. Over that time, Anchor has grown rapidly. In 2020-21 as demand for packaging accelerated, Anchor expanded its domestic production capacity by 30%, adding eight new lines and 100,000 square feet.  
  
Anchor offers robust custom design and packaging solution development capabilities. These include small tool flexibility for nimble early-stage development and some of the highest-capacity inline production lines in the world. These high-capacity lines enable us to produce at maximum efficiency, minimizing customer costs.  
  
Anchor’s product line capabilities include hot (up to 230 degrees), refrigerated, and ambient temperature protection. Anchor manufactures entirely in the US, producing containers using polypropylene (PP) and PET, two of the most highly recycled plastic packaging materials. Anchor produces at extremely high standards with a scrap rate under 0.5%. Anchor serves customers across multiple channels, including restaurants, retail, supermarkets, convenience, businesses, and education.  
  
Anchor is headquartered in St Louis, MO, with production and distribution facilities in Arkansas and Wisconsin. In 2019, Anchor became the first packaging company in Arkansas, home to the majority of our facilities, to be recognized for excellence in on-the-job safety after reaching 5 million man-hours without a lost-time, work-related injury or illness. Today, Anchor employs over 1,000 people and operates over two million square feet of production and distribution facilities.

About Houston Grand Opera
-------------------------

Since its inception in 1955, Houston Grand Opera has grown from a small regional organization into an internationally renowned opera company. HGO enjoys a reputation for commissioning and producing new works, including 61 world premieres and seven American premieres since 1973. In addition to producing and performing world-class opera, HGO contributes to the cultural enrichment of Houston and the nation through a diverse and innovative program of performances, community events, and education projects that reaches the widest possible public. HGO has toured extensively, including trips to Europe and Asia, and has won a Tony, two Grammy awards, and two Emmy awards—the only opera company to have won all three honors.  
  
Through HGO Community and Learning, Houston Grand Opera creates opportunities for Houstonians of all ages and backgrounds to observe, participate in, and create art. The NEXUS Initiative is HGO’s multi-year ticket underwriting program that allows Houstonians of all ages and backgrounds to enjoy world-class opera without the barrier of price. Since 2007 NEXUS has enabled more than 225,000 Houstonians to experience first-quality opera through discounted single tickets and subscriptions, subsidized student performances, and free productions.

About Power Gems
----------------

For over 30 years, the largest rental companies and motion picture studios worldwide have chosen Power Gems to supply one key element in the lighting system used in film and TV production - the electronic ballast.  
  
Power Gems, established in 1991, is the biggest independent designer and manufacturer of HMI ballasts. The lighting equipment uses the latest silicon carbide technology to control the arc in HMI lights, to provide the 'flicker-free' light required for location filming.  
  
Not a year goes by without a new addition to the Power Gems family or refresh of the core 20 product lines - many are regarded as workhorses of the industry.  
  
Initially developed for use in film and television production, Power Gems have been adapted for new markets: solar simulation, high speed photography and events. For many OEMs we are the preferred supplier, helping to bring their products to market.  
  
We recognise an increasing demand in the lighting market as LED efficiency continues to rise, and there is imperative to remove mercury from the system. Our new range of high power LED products for the control market harness our knowledge of very high power fixtures for HMI. As a long-standing manufacturer of flicker-free lighting power supplies, we ensure our LED range meets the same high standards you have come to expect from Power Gems.  
  
POWER GEMS Ltd  
The Power Gems corporate headquarters, located in Fairhills Trade Centre, Irlam, UK, is the primary location for R&D, sales, customer support and all stages of production through to final assembly, testing and packaging.  
  
POWER GEMS CORPORATION  
Our Hollywood facility provides sales and technical support for customers in North America. The wholly-owned subsidiary, Power Gems Corporation, is staffed by factory-trained engineers and carries a large stock of finished product, and original spares for servicing.

About Tessa Dahl

Tessa Dahl is a talented British author who has made a name for herself in the world of literature. Born as the daughter of the celebrated children's author, Roald Dahl, Tessa has followed in her father's footsteps and carved out her own successful career as a writer. With a unique and engaging writing style, she has captivated readers with her captivating storytelling and unforgettable characters.  
  
Tessa Dahl's literary journey began with the publication of her first novel, "Working for Love," in 1987. This debut work received widespread acclaim and established Tessa as a formidable talent in the literary world. Drawing on her own experiences and observations, Tessa crafted a compelling narrative that resonated with readers on a deeply personal level. Her ability to weave together complex emotions and relationships with a keen insight into the human experience set her apart as a writer to watch.  
  
In addition to her novels, Tessa Dahl has also penned a number of insightful and thought-provoking non-fiction works. Her memoir, "My Father's Daughter: A Memoir," provided readers with an intimate glimpse into her life growing up as the daughter of a literary legend. With candor and wit, Tessa delved into her relationships with her famous father and the impact that his success had on her own journey. Through her memoir, she offered a poignant and honest portrayal of family dynamics, fame, and the complexities of growing up in the spotlight.  
  
Tessa Dahl's unique perspective and gift for storytelling have earned her a dedicated following of readers who eagerly anticipate each new release. Her ability to create compelling narratives that transport readers to different worlds and time periods is a testament to her skill as a writer. Whether she is crafting a work of fiction or sharing her own experiences through memoir, Tessa's writing has an undeniable power to resonate with audiences and leave a lasting impression.  
  
In addition to her writing, Tessa Dahl has also become known for her work as a television presenter and journalist. About The Collier Companies
---------------------------

Our story began on December 27, 1972, when our Founder and Chairman, Nathan S. Collier, purchased a modest single duplex in Gainesville, Florida. He then continued to steadily expand his real estate portfolio, acquiring three or four properties each year, championing the entrepreneurial energy that is integral to our company’s success.  
  
By January of 1980, Collier had earned a strong reputation along with the trust of local investors and lenders. His portfolio grew to 25 homes in College Park, a neighborhood just north of The University of Florida.  
  
Since our humble beginnings, our company’s intuition and ambition have allowed us to reach many more landmark achievements. Now known as The Collier Companies, our organization adopted the principles of The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People as the cornerstone of our company’s culture. These tenets became deeply woven into our corporate culture, inspiring us to rebrand our properties in College Park with the name ‘Paradigm Properties’. This would serve us as a poignant, lasting reminder to view the world with a strong sense of awareness and insight.  
  
Today, The Collier Companies stands as the largest provider of student housing owned by a private individual in the nation. Our portfolio comprises over 12,000 apartment homes in the Southeast region of the United States, continuing to grow and expand. We’ve set our sights on success with an aggressive initiative to double our number of apartment homes over the next decade. We credit our legacy to our deep-rooted company culture and a dedicated team of people who are unified by their entrepreneurial spirit and love of learning.

With nearly a 100 films to our credits including The Fast and The Furious 7, Guardians of the Galaxy, The Mortal Instruments, Pompeii, Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance and The Resident Evil Series, we are sought after by the best storytellers, filmmakers and facilities world over for our expertise, experience, talent and complete commitment to create stunning imagery for Films, TV, Apps and Mobiles.  
  
Founded in 2006, today we are an award-winning visual effects and creative studio that is a leading destination for high-end global VFX in India. We are passionate about crafting your story through breathtaking visuals by blending cutting-edge technology and top of the line creativity. Dedication, excellence, communication and world class delivery are deeply etched in our DNA. Our State of the facility is a secure fortress that is Marvel and Disney certified. Whether it be complex creature work such as full CGI tigers, crocodiles, snakes, or it be set extensions, particle effects and matte painting, roto, prep or matchmove, Anibrain provides high-end work on the biggest blockbusters in production through partnering with the best VFX facilities globally.

About ICPC - International Collegiate Programming Contest

The ICPC is affiliated with the ICPC Foundation. Operating with the auspices of the ICPC Foundation and headquartered at Baylor University, the ICPC Community is a global volunteer community of faculty, students, and professionals operating on six continents at 3,000 universities that annual conduct the International Collegiate Programming Contest.  
  
The ICPC is an academically credentialed competition among the universities of the world. Joining with industry and community, the ICPC seeks to raise performance and aspirations of the most gifted problem solvers in the computing sciences by instilling habits of excellence in the next generation of problem solvers.  
  
Established in 1970 with the auspices of UPE which continue to this day, the first finals held in 1977. The competition is sometimes referred to as the ICPC Battle of the Brains and the Olympics of Competitive Programming.  
  
The ICPC is the historical root of all programming competitions.

What is the International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC)?

The International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) is a prestigious competitive programming competition for university students worldwide. It promotes collaboration, problem-solving, and programming skills among participants. The contest is organized by the ICPC Foundation and is hosted by various universities, with Baylor University serving as its headquarters. ICPC aims to foster a spirit of teamwork and innovation in computer science and programming.

How can universities participate in the ICPC?

Universities interested in participating in the ICPC can do so by forming teams of students and registering through their respective regional contest. Each university typically has a faculty advisor who oversees the team and coordinates participation. The ICPC has a structured regional contest system that leads to the World Finals, allowing universities to compete at various levels. For more information, universities can visit the ICPC website or contact their regional contest organizers.

What types of skills do participants develop through the ICPC?

Participants in the ICPC develop a wide range of skills, including advanced problem-solving, algorithm design, and programming proficiency in multiple languages. The competition encourages teamwork and collaboration, as teams must work together to solve complex problems under time constraints. Additionally, participants gain experience in competitive programming, which is valuable for careers in software development, data science, and other technology-related fields.

Are there resources available for students preparing for the ICPC?

Yes, there are numerous resources available for students preparing for the ICPC. The ICPC website offers access to past contest problems, solutions, and practice materials. Additionally, many universities host training sessions and workshops to help students improve their programming skills. Online platforms and communities also provide tutorials, coding challenges, and forums where students can collaborate and share knowledge.

What industries benefit from the skills developed through ICPC participation?

The skills developed through ICPC participation are highly sought after in various industries, including software development, finance, data analysis, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. Companies in technology and engineering fields value the problem-solving abilities, coding expertise, and teamwork skills that ICPC participants demonstrate. Many former participants go on to have successful careers in top tech firms, startups, and research institutions.

How does ICPC promote diversity and inclusion in competitive programming?

ICPC is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion within the competitive programming community. The organization actively encourages participation from underrepresented groups in technology, including women and minorities. Initiatives such as outreach programs, scholarships, and mentorship opportunities are designed to create a more inclusive environment. ICPC also collaborates with universities and organizations to host events that celebrate diversity and foster a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

About Lilly Architects
----------------------

At Lilly Architects, our design professionals believe good design is timeless and has the power to have a positive impact on quality of life. We also believe in superior design service that offers excellent solutions formulated in direct response to each client’s program, budget, and schedule.  
  
Lilly Architects’ work is grounded in deep-rooted architectural virtues, where architecture is both practical and graceful. These requirements realize their potential in buildings through durability and integrity, the efficient arrangement of spaces, and aesthetic quality through imparted style, proportion, and visual beauty. Our commitment to this is evident in the professional craftsmanship of our designs and the sense of harmony between our work and its context.  
  
Our practice, founded in 2013, builds upon the principle that all endeavored projects receive our full attention and commitment. Embracing the reality that architectural design is an evolutionary process from concept to completion, we are well equipped to facilitate an efficient and smooth project delivery. We focus on identifying and revealing the essential factors that uniquely bring strength and vitality to each project.  
  
Our design process is committed to this pursuit; from asking the right questions, to research, to providing fully integrated solutions. Our work includes cultural & institutional, mixed-use development, workplace, multi-family residential, retail, education, hospitality, and historic preservation.

About Robert Glasper

Robert Glasper is an American pianist and record producer who has revolutionized the world of jazz music with his unique blend of styles and innovative approach to the art form. With a career spanning over two decades, Glasper has collaborated with some of the biggest names in the industry, seamlessly fusing jazz with elements of hip-hop, R&B, and soul to create a fresh sound that appeals to a wide range of listeners.  
  
Born and raised in Houston, Texas, Glasper began his musical journey at a young age. He was introduced to jazz by his mother, who was a professional pianist herself. Under her guidance, Glasper quickly developed a deep appreciation for the genre and began honing his skills on the piano. His natural talent and dedication earned him a scholarship to study at the New School for Jazz and Contemporary Music in New York City, where he was able to further refine his craft and experiment with different styles.  
  
It was during his time at the New School that Glasper started to make a name for himself in the jazz scene. He began performing at various clubs around the city and caught the attention of influential figures in the industry. Word of his exceptional talent spread quickly, and he soon found himself collaborating with renowned musicians such as Christian McBride, Terence Blanchard, and Roy Hargrove. These collaborations not only helped establish Glasper as a talented pianist but also allowed him to expand his musical palette and explore new avenues within the jazz genre.  
  
One of Glasper's defining characteristics as an artist is his ability to seamlessly blend different genres without compromising the integrity of jazz. His music effortlessly incorporates elements of hip-hop, R&B, and soul, giving it a modern and relatable edge. This unique fusion has attracted a diverse fanbase, broadening the reach of jazz and bringing it to a new generation who may not have otherwise been exposed to the genre.  
  
In addition to his successful career as a performing artist, Glasper has also found great success as a record producer. He has worked with some of the biggest names in the music industry, including Erykah Badu, Maxwell, and Common, helping them create critically acclaimed albums that have pushed the boundaries of their respective genres. Glasper's keen ear for production and his ability to think outside the box have made him a sought-after collaborator, and his contributions to these projects have further solidified his position as a visionary in the music industry.  
  
Throughout his career, Glasper has received numerous accolades for his groundbreaking work. He has won several Grammy Awards, including Best R&B Album for his album "Black Radio" and Best Traditional R&B Performance for his collaboration with Ledisi on the song "Gonna Be Alright (F.T.B.)." These awards serve as a testament to Glasper's unparalleled talent and his ability to consistently push the boundaries of jazz and redefine what the genre can be.  
  
In summary, Robert Glasper is an iconic figure in the world of jazz music. His unique blend of styles, innovative approach to the genre, and collaborations with influential artists have propelled him to the forefront of the industry. With his ability to seamlessly fuse jazz with elements of hip-hop, R&B, and soul, Glasper has created a modern sound that appeals to a wide range of listeners. As a pianist and record producer, he continues to challenge conventions, push boundaries, and inspire future generations of musicians to think outside the box and create music that is both innovative and timeless.

About William Rawn Associates, Architects, Inc.
-----------------------------------------------

William Rawn Associates, Architects, Inc., in Boston, formed in 1983, has completed a large number of projects, ranging from complex urban buildings to college campuses, from performing arts facilities to affordable housing. Best known is the 1,200-seat Seiji Ozawa Hall for the Boston Symphony Orchestra at Tanglewood, named by Leo Beranek’s Concert Halls and Opera Houses as one of the best concert halls in the US in terms of acoustics (#4), and the second best concert hall built in the US in the past 50 years. Recently completed projects include the Rubenstein Arts Center at Duke University, Boston Public library Johnson Building Transformation, Harvard Business School Klarman Hall, and King Open / Cambridge Upper Street Schools & Community Complex.  
  
William Rawn Associates is committed to buildings participating in the civic or public realm — buildings in the city, buildings on campus, or buildings in important public landscape settings. We believe that successful architecture, through the active engagement of its civic context, fosters the values of diversity and participation. We are proud of the design recognition we have received. The firm’s 16 National Honor Awards from the national American Institute of Architects, placing it in the top half-dozen firms nationally in the number of such awards received.  
  
William Rawn Associates was ranked #1 (2009), #2 (2014, 2012), #3 (in 2011, 2018), and #4 (2013) in ARCHITECT Magazine’s annual list of the nation’s top 50 firms. It was also named the industry leader in sustainable practices by ARCHITECT in 2011. In the past twenty years, the firm has won over 250+ national, regional, city and state AIA Awards and other design awards.

---------------------

South West TAFE are a Victorian State leader in innovative and professional education services. Training students for the future, whilst unleashing their potential for successful careers, we provide a forward-thinking approach to education and offer a wide range of in-demand courses.  
  
We are the the largest and highest regarded training provider in south-west Victoria, with a primary aim of providing future focused education that creates a lifetime of opportunity and employability.  
  
Our teachers, training facilities, support services and direct links with industry are second to none, and to ensure that the skills training we provide is for in-demand jobs, we actively develop training programs to help address regional skills shortages. As a result, graduates have a very high chance of finding employment and excelling in their chosen field.  
  
We offer a wide range of accredited qualifications, plus short courses and stand-alone units from industry training packages.  
  
Campuses are located in Warrnambool, Portland, Hamilton, and Colac with facilities and services set to expand as the region grows.

About Highway Inn Companies
---------------------------

Highway Inn has been in continuous business since 1947, serving Hawaiian and American Food to the people of Oahu. Hailing from the west-side of Oahu, Highway Inn was established by Japanese Immigrants who had recently returned to Hawaii after being interned for much of World War II. After some 66 years in Waipahu, Highway Inn, under the leadership of its third generation of owner expanded its operations to bring the Island's best-loved Hawaiian Food Restaurant to Kaka'ako in Honolulu, and then to the Bishop Museum.  
Highway Inn is famous for its Hawaiian Food. Hawaiian Food is the amalgamation of all the locally grown food that was native and brought to the Islands by successive waves of immigrants and settlers over the last few hundred years. Hawaiian staples are poi, taro leaves, lau laus, and poke. More recent innovations are pipikaula, haupia, squid luau, lomi salmon, beef stew, kalua pig, and nowadays we add ribs, burgers, quesadillas, tacos, salads, and appetizers, all made with some local flair.  
In 2010 Guy Fieri from the Food Network visited and showcased Hawaiian Food to his viewers. Over the years, Highway Inn has won many awards from and via the local media, business, and government organizations and is perennially a winner of Best Hawaiian Restaurant on Honolulu Magazine’s Hale ‘Aina award. Recently, In May 2017 Highway Inn won USA Today’s Best Kalua Pig Sandwich in the State Competition and won the Honolulu Star Advertiser’s Hawaii’s Best Hawaiian Food in 2018 and 2019.

About Kathryn Toolan

Kathryn Toolan is a dedicated Yoga Instructor at The Yoga Shop of Old Saybrook, where she combines her passion for movement and creativity with a deep commitment to fostering self-awareness and personal growth in her students. With a background that emphasizes core strength, injury prevention, and wellness, Kathryn has developed a unique teaching style that empowers individuals to explore their physical capabilities while nurturing their mental well-being. Her expertise in stress management and self-esteem building allows her to create a supportive environment where students can cultivate confidence and self-love through their practice.  
  
At The Yoga Shop, Kathryn leads a variety of classes tailored to meet the diverse needs of her students, from beginners seeking to establish a foundational practice to experienced yogis looking to deepen their skills. She is particularly passionate about integrating strength training and stretching techniques into her sessions, helping students enhance their athletic performance and overall physical resilience. One of her key projects includes developing specialized workshops that focus on mindfulness and body awareness, enabling participants to connect more deeply with their inner selves and discover the transformative power of yoga.  
  
Kathryn's commitment to her students extends beyond the mat; she is also certified in Child CPR, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for all ages. Her journey in yoga has not only enriched her own life but has also inspired countless others to embark on their paths toward inner happiness and strength. Through her teachings, Kathryn continues to make a lasting impact, instilling a sense of achievement and self-esteem in everyone she encounters.

Matteo Milone is a results-driven Head of Growth at Maximum International Corp., a Canadian multinational specializing in water treatment systems and dispensing solutions. At Maximum International Corp., Matteo leads key projects that focus on enhancing the customer journey through data-driven insights and targeted campaigns. By leveraging his skills in e-commerce, mobile marketing, and social media, he has successfully coordinated cross-functional teams to launch impactful advertising initiatives that not only increase brand visibility but also foster customer loyalty. His analytical approach to marketing allows him to dissect complex data sets, enabling the company to make informed decisions that enhance overall performance.  
  
As the Founder of RoiX10, Matteo has honed his skills in email marketing and sales management, further enriching his capabilities in driving growth. His commitment to team leadership and collaboration ensures that all stakeholders are aligned with the company’s vision, ultimately leading to exceptional results. With a keen eye for emerging trends and a strategic mindset, Matteo continues to push the boundaries of what is possible in the water treatment industry, making a lasting impact on both Maximum International Corp. and the broader market.

About Seetal Bhatti

Seetal Bhatti currently serves as the Director of HR for BT Business, where she plays a pivotal role in reshaping the human resources landscape to drive organizational transformation and enhance business performance. With a robust background as the former Chief Human Resources Officer for BT’s Global division, Seetal was appointed to her current role in March 2023, following the strategic merger of BT's B2B divisions. This move aims to revitalize BT’s enterprise segment, which has faced challenges in recent years, and position the company as a leader in providing innovative networking, security, voice, cloud, and managed service solutions to over 2 million customers across 180 countries.  
  
In her capacity as a strategic partner to CEOs and executive committees, Seetal leverages her expertise in change management and leadership development to influence and empower leaders within the organization. Her focus on building customer-centric, adaptive, and high-performance teams is crucial in navigating the complexities of the modern business landscape. The Bunn-O-Matic® Corporation – A History of Innovation and Commitment  
  
Understanding and responding to customer requirements has always been important to the Bunn-O-Matic Corporation (BUNN®). Today, BUNN is a global partner you can count on for profitable, reliable beverage equipment and outstanding post-purchase support wherever customers are served.  
  
Since 1957, BUNN has been at the forefront of beverage equipment innovation: inventing the flat-bottom paper filter for commercial use, the pour-over coffee brewer, and the first commercial iced tea brewer that uses fresh leaves versus instant mix. As customers entered the digital age, BUNN also embraced sophisticated new technology to meet changing needs.  
  
Each product launch is driven by an ongoing commitment to delivering the highest possible quality beverage in each cup, every time. With thousands of loyal commercial and home product customers, the BUNN brand is synonymous with honesty, integrity, courtesy and total value, all of which work together to uphold the company’s brand promise, A Partner You Can Count On™.  
  
The global headquarters are located in Springfield, Illinois, USA, where the company strives for total customer satisfaction through superior equipment and unmatched service with support from facilities in Iowa, the New York metro area, California, as well as in Mexico, Canada, United Kingdom, Germany, China, Hong Kong, and Brazil.

About Halo Privacy

Halo Privacy was founded by like-minded experts with many years of experience in government and industrial secure communications who believe that genuine privacy is still possible. The Halo approach to securing privacy goes beyond just hardware and technology. A keen understanding that the greatest threats to privacy are often human, coupled with the know-how to assume an attacker’s perspective, have allowed Halo to protect the most sensitive information for grateful clients in the government and private sectors.  Through a combination sophisticated intelligence tradecraft, streamlined training and proprietary disruptive technology, Halo offers every client a tailored privacy solution. For customers from government entities to corporations to family offices seeking a low profile, we place a secure “Halo” around our clients’ smartphones, laptops, smart homes and businesses that protects the information, intellectual property and personal privacy of everyone and everything inside the “Halo.” Simple training and concierge-level staff support ensure frictionless client use of the Halo systems. In fact, anyone who can manage email and a smartphone is already savvy enough to communicate securely within the Halo.

What services does Halo Privacy offer to enhance secure communications?

Halo Privacy specializes in providing advanced encryption solutions that ensure secure communications for both individuals and organizations. Their services include end-to-end encryption for messaging and file sharing, secure email solutions, and privacy-focused communication platforms that protect user data from unauthorized access. Additionally, they offer consulting services to help organizations implement secure communication protocols tailored to their specific needs.

How does Halo Privacy ensure user anonymity in its services?

Halo Privacy employs a multi-layered approach to user anonymity, utilizing techniques such as mis-attribution and advanced encryption methods. By obfuscating user identities and employing secure routing protocols, Halo Privacy ensures that user data remains confidential and untraceable. Their solutions are designed to protect users' identities while they communicate or share information online, making it difficult for third parties to monitor or track their activities.

What industries can benefit from Halo Privacy's solutions?

Halo Privacy's solutions are applicable across various industries, including government, healthcare, finance, and technology. Organizations in these sectors often handle sensitive information that requires robust security measures. Halo Privacy's encryption and secure communication services help these industries comply with regulations, protect client data, and maintain confidentiality in their communications, ultimately enhancing trust and security.

Can Halo Privacy help secure smart home devices?

Yes, Halo Privacy offers solutions specifically designed to enhance the security of smart home devices. Their expertise in secure communications and encryption can be applied to protect IoT devices from potential vulnerabilities and unauthorized access. By implementing secure protocols and encryption methods, Halo Privacy helps ensure that smart home systems remain safe from cyber threats, providing peace of mind for users.

What makes Halo Privacy different from other privacy-focused companies?

Halo Privacy stands out due to its foundation of experienced professionals who have extensive backgrounds in secure communications within government and industrial sectors. Their commitment to genuine privacy is reflected in their innovative solutions that prioritize user security and anonymity. Unlike many competitors, Halo Privacy emphasizes a holistic approach to privacy, integrating advanced technology with a deep understanding of the regulatory landscape and user needs.

How can I get started with Halo Privacy's services?

Getting started with Halo Privacy is simple. Interested individuals or organizations can visit their website to explore the range of services offered. They provide detailed information on each solution, along with case studies and testimonials. For personalized assistance, potential clients can reach out through the contact form or schedule a consultation to discuss their specific privacy needs and how Halo Privacy can help address them.

\-Porque nuestro personal está en constante capacitación y entrenamiento.  
\-Porque el servicio que brindamos es producto de un análisis particular a cada cliente.

About Vox Novus
---------------

Vox Novus promotes contemporary music through performances, recordings, publications, and broadcasts.  
  
Vox Novus believes strongly in the intrinsic value of contemporary music, recognizing it as a force in the advancement of culture. The goal is to strengthen the connection between composer and audience, providing greater exposure to new music.  
  
Vox Novus understands that without the creation of challenging, contemporary music there will be no future masterpieces to reflect our time. Exciting new music is being composed constantly, and must be heard in order to complete the cycle of creativity. Vox Novus gets contemporary music heard: in live performances, television and radio broadcasts, compact discs, and over the Internet.  
  
Vox Novus develops, produces, and promotes opportunities for composers. These opportunities come in the form of the projects housed by Vox Novus such as 60x60, Composer's Voice, and Fifteen-Minutes-of-Fame, expanding the audience for new music beyond the established music community.  
  
Vox Novus projects aim to build a new repertoire by creating "friendly" listening environments that integrate a growing body of contemporary composers. Programming is repeated to foster familiarity with this repertoire.  
  
Vox Novus promotes and produces contemporary music using repeatable methods and models that composers can take and use on their own. This way contemporary music can reach an ever wider audience thereby continuing the advancement of culture and art.

About Vocalist- Jazz, Blues And Traditional Pop
-----------------------------------------------

www.SkinnyLlamaProductions.com  
  
Latest Production: Golden Orchid CD  
  
This recording started with one week left to film the 'boys in the band' (who are in the film, The Mexcio Jazz Tour: The Movie, which Patrice Villastrigo was filming) before they all departed San Miguel de Allende, Mexico, after the last tour concert and went their separate ways.  
  
With their own performance rehearsals and gigs, both with the tour band and with others, they had little time to devote to this CD project. But they did it! They had one afternoon to rehearse and two afternoons to record! Then Gene Perla took over the project at his studio in Pennsylvania.  
  
One of the tunes on this CD, Clueless In Dallas, was recorded in San Antonio at GO Studios. Written by Joel C. Williams, who also played keyboard on this. Spot Barnett on tenor saxophone and Oscar Laun on Bongos, with all 4 of us on percussion. The wind was created by Joel and Patrice blowing into the microphone! This tune can be found in the Poison Oaks film score.  
  
"What a blessing that I have had the opportunity to work with all of these very talented and authentic musicians! A special "THANKS" goes to dear friend, Richie Cole, without whose encouragement I may not have accomplished this CD!" Patrice  
  
Other CDs by Patrice:  
  
A Song For You  
Careful With My Heart  
  
You may read about Patrice and her music at http://www.cdbaby.com/Artist/PatriceVillastrigo

Afrik Interim is an ISO 9001:2008 Certified International Human Resources Company founded in 2005 with well-established entities in Africa, Europe and Canada (https://www.linkedin.com/company/afrik-interim-canada). We place our customers at the center of all of our activities. We believe in delivering a first class, personalized service for both employers and candidates.  
  
Wherever you are, Afrik Interim assists you in finding the appropriate profile for the position to be filled. A committed Panafricanist, Afrik Interim draws on representations across the continent (Brazzaville – Pointe Noir – Nairobi – Johannesburg, and Kinshasa as the headquarters of the company in Africa). We also have strong representation in a dozen offices in the provinces of DR Congo, as well as branches in Belgium and Canada.  
  
Afrik Interim group provides customized value added solutions and services that respond to the evolving needs of organizations and top talents.

ISO 9001:2008: In April 2012, Afrik interim obtained ISO 9001:2008 certification. This international certification demonstrates the continuous improvement of our performance and ensures a consistent level of service quality.  
  
A LOCAL PRESENCE WITH A LOCAL REACH: As a global recruitment firm we can provide accurate, accessible solutions - whether you are a multi-national or a smaller regional or local organization, we have the global coverage and local knowledge to meet any recruitment need.

\- International/national/inter-provincial recruitment

\- Cultural differences, Adaptation

About Mark Clattenburg

Mark Clattenburg is an English former association football referee who is widely regarded as one of the best referees of his generation. Born on March 13, 1975, in Consett, County Durham, Clattenburg began his refereeing career in the Northern League before progressing to the Football League and eventually the Premier League. Known for his calm and composed demeanor on the pitch, Clattenburg officiated some of the biggest matches in world football, including the finals of the UEFA Champions League and the European Championship.  
  
Clattenburg's rise through the ranks of English refereeing was swift, and he soon established himself as a prominent figure in the game. His strong decision-making and effective communication with players and coaches earned him widespread respect among his peers and the footballing community as a whole. In 2004, Clattenburg became a Select Group referee, marking his official recognition as one of the top officials in English football. From then on, he consistently delivered high-quality performances, earning praise for his ability to control and manage high-pressure fixtures.  
  
One of the key moments in Clattenburg's career came in 2012 when he was selected to officiate the Olympic men's football final at the London Games. This honor further solidified his reputation as a top-class referee on the international stage. In the same year, Clattenburg achieved another milestone by refereeing the FA Cup final, capping off a highly successful season for him. His achievements continued to mount, and in 2016, he was chosen to officiate the UEFA Champions League final between Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid, a testament to his excellence and expertise in refereeing.  
  
Clattenburg's tenure as a Premier League referee was distinguished by his consistent application of the laws of the game and his unwavering commitment to fairness and integrity. He was known for his willingness to make tough decisions when required, never shying away from difficult calls even in the most high-profile matches. His ability to remain composed and unfazed in high-stakes situations earned him the trust and admiration of players, managers, and fans alike. Clattenburg's understanding of the game and his ability to interpret and enforce the rules with precision set him apart as an exceptional referee.  
  
In addition to his domestic success, Clattenburg's international refereeing career was equally impressive. He officiated numerous high-profile matches in UEFA competitions and was selected by FIFA to serve as a referee in several major tournaments. His inclusion in the officiating team for the 2016 UEFA European Championship in France was a testament to his standing as one of the top referees in world football. Clattenburg's performances in the tournament received widespread acclaim, further enhancing his reputation as a top-class official.  
  
Following a highly successful career in refereeing, Clattenburg announced his retirement from on-field officiating in 2017 to take on a new role as the head of refereeing for the Football Association of Saudi Arabia. His decision to move into a leadership position reflected his desire to share his knowledge and expertise with the next generation of referees. In his new role, Clattenburg was responsible for overseeing the development and training of referees in Saudi Arabia, aiming to elevate the standard of officiating in the country.  
  
In addition to his work in Saudi Arabia, Clattenburg also became a regular contributor to media outlets, providing expert analysis and insight into refereeing decisions and the application of the laws of the game. His articulate and clear explanations endeared him to audiences, further solidifying his status as a respected authority on refereeing matters. Clattenburg's contributions to the media played a crucial role in enhancing public understanding of the complexities of refereeing and the challenges faced by officials during matches.  
  
In recognition of his outstanding contributions to the sport, Clattenburg was awarded the Referee of the Year accolade multiple times, underscoring his impact and influence on the game. His legacy as one of the finest referees in English and international football remains indelible, with his impeccable track record and keen understanding of the nuances of the game setting him apart as a true ambassador for the sport.  
  
In conclusion, Mark Clattenburg's distinguished career as a football referee represents the epitome of excellence and professionalism. His exemplary performances on the domestic and international stages, coupled with his unyielding commitment to upholding the integrity of the game, have cemented his legacy as one of the greatest referees of his generation. As he continues to make significant contributions to the sport in his post-retirement endeavors, Clattenburg's enduring impact on the world of football remains as strong as ever.

About Stand & Deliver
---------------------

Stand & Deliver is a global leadership communication consulting and training firm. We help leaders and their teams engage, influence and inspire others--and produce real-world results.  
  
Stand & Deliver programs are about much more than just communication skills. They are about mindfulness--the psychodynamics of powerful and authentic connection--and they challenge leaders to examine how they engage and relate to themselves, to each other, to their organizations, and to the world.  
  
Stand & Deliver consultants are acclaimed for their ability to unleash hidden potential in leaders.  
  
Our programs are built on a core triad of skills:  
  
Content: Effective leadership-communication requires a clear, compelling message. We've created a narrative-architecture tool that you can apply in any speaking situation to ensure your message is relevant and focused.  
  
Delivery: Ideas don't speak for themselves. Too often, important messages don't get heard because they're communicated in ways that obscure the speaker's authentic passion, excitement or conviction. We help you bring your content to life by ensuring your body, voice and eyes are congruent with your words--to ensure your point sticks.  
  
State: State of mind is the most neglected component of high-stakes communication. It's also the most important. Strong content and delivery cannot overcome a poor state. The techniques we offer for cultivating an optimum state will give you a repeatable routine for directing your focus to produce peak performance on command. You'll be prepared to manage your emotions and focus before any event--whether you're addressing an audience of one or one thousand.  
  
Experiential Learning: We believe in learning by doing, and our programs are highly participatory. Our intimate faculty-to-participant ratio ensures that everyone practices in a supportive, encouraging environment where they can take risks and receive constructive, relevant feedback.

About Us  
MunckMusic is a live music recording and marketing company. Our mission is to help bands, musicians, and music festivals generate auxiliary income by recording their live performances and distributing the recordings to music fans at a fair price.  
  
  
MunckMusic (pronounced monk-music) can do this because we combine the latest technology with innovative marketing and low overhead costs. We record, mix, and master most of the recordings ourselves and make all of them available at reasonable prices on both CDs and DRM-free downloads at our online music store. For many bands and music festivals we also produce instant CDs (and other digital media) at concert venues so fans can take home a recording of the performance they just heard immediately after the show.  
  
  
So, whether you’re a musician seeking listeners, or a listener seeking music - we’re there to aid you in your quest.

About & Other Stories
---------------------

We believe in sharing stories. Our concept is built around inviting customers to be involved in the creative process behind the brand. We share everything from the sketch of a shoe to the behind-the-scenes of a photo shoot, and views from our ateliers in Paris, Stockholm and Los Angeles. Words such as personal, diverse and uncomplicated are present in everything we do. We aim to create collections for all fashion-loving women. We want to encourage personal style with our wide range of products and make everyone feel welcome. By keeping things uncomplicated and flexible, it’s easy for us to adapt to new visions and different collections as fashion always changes. That’s the beauty of it! Our collections are designed in our three ateliers: Paris, Stockholm and Los Angeles. They are each fantastic yet very different cities. We love the contrast between the passionate Parisian atmosphere, the minimalistic, pragmatic Stockholm feel, and the laidback Los Angeles vibe, and especially what happens when they all come together.  
  
Each person working with & Other Stories is an essential part of our group of creatives and valued individual within the company. We believe in being spontaneous, personal and flexible, which makes it easy to collaborate within all parts of our brand and enables growth, for you and us. Currently, & Other Stories has over 1,500 employees and continues to expand, opening more stores around the world.

About American Immunization Registry Association
------------------------------------------------

For over 20 years, AIRA has been a leader in the immunization information system (IIS) community. We’re a national nonprofit on a mission to promote the use of immunization information to ensure healthy communities. IIS have been on the front lines in the fight to end the COVID-19 pandemic, and AIRA has been hard at work since the beginning to find ways to support our members.  
  
How we serve the IIS community:  
AIRA strives to be a champion for and the voice of the IIS community. We actively engage with our partners to identify issues and trends that may impact IIS, gather feedback on key issues, and elevate IIS successes, needs, and challenges on a national stage to make sure IIS are fully supported and represented. We are a strong, unified voice for standards, policy, and funding. We take pride in being a resource for data exchange standards development, information sharing, and education/training for IIS managers and staff.  
  
“Thank you for your continued work and dedication helping decision makers and the public understand immunizations and IIS.” –Dave McCormick, AIRA member and past board president  
  
Our members:  
AIRA relies on thoughtful, smart, engaged, and innovative members and volunteers to collaboratively achieve our mission and vision. For over 20 years, we’ve worked cooperatively with our members to grow and serve the IIS community. There are currently 800 AIRA members representing 93 member organizations.  
  
“AIRA…is a stellar exemplar of what a public health membership association can do for its members in helping the community work together, to learn together, to share, to grow together, in achieving a really important mission.” –Bill Brand, former director at the Public Health Informatics Institute  
  
Our team:  
The AIRA team is made up of talented professionals from all over the country with over 226 years of combined experience working with IIS and immunization programs! If you’re interested in joining our team, follow our page for the latest job openings.

(LMI), Mavis has honed her skills over 15 years, working across various sectors and cultures to deliver impactful leadership and management solutions. Her current role as a Human Factor Programmes Specialist encompasses a diverse array of key projects focused on critical areas such as Stress Management, Anger Management, and Personal Energy Management.  
  
Mavis's approach is deeply rooted in behavioral science, allowing her to tailor programs that address the unique challenges faced by organizations today. She is particularly adept at facilitating critical conversations that foster employee engagement and promote a culture of innovation. Her workshops on Creativity and Innovation not only inspire teams but also equip them with the tools necessary to navigate the complexities of modern business environments.  
  
In addition to her facilitation skills, Mavis's background in organizational development and succession planning positions her as a strategic partner for businesses looking to enhance their leadership capabilities. Her research-driven methodologies ensure that her coaching and training programs are not only relevant but also measurable in terms of impact. By integrating her knowledge of human resources and business strategy, Mavis empowers organizations to cultivate resilient leaders who can thrive in an ever-evolving landscape. Through her work, she continues to make a significant contribution to the field of leadership development, helping individuals and organizations unlock their full potential.

Our GS and Yuasa product ranges include some of the most well-recognised, trusted and high quality battery products for use in a diverse range of automotive, motorcycle, industrial and standby power applications.  
  
Supported by experienced Quality Assurance, Technical Support, Marketing and Customer Service teams, our industry leading service and distribution network continues to set new standards in customer care, choice and year-round availability.  
  
GS Yuasa Battery Sales UK Ltd is a subsidiary of the word-leading GS Yuasa Corporation which consists of 65 subsidiaries and 33 affiliates in countries throughout the world.  
  
For over 100 years, the GS Yuasa Group has continually contributed to economic development and the improvement of living standards through the development and manufacture of batteries, power supply systems and lighting equipment.  
  
Responding to today’s increasingly sophisticated needs, our extensive range of next generation energy system lithium-ion batteries encompasses not only vehicle use but also products in a wide range of fields, from deep sea to aerospace, to meet the ever more sophisticated needs of the times.
